body:
The latest news from the Republican Party of Wisconsin

| | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=1)
---
### November 29, 2021
Friend -- We hope you had a joyful and safe Thanksgiving surrounded by loved ones. This year, we are grateful for our friends and supporters who comprise the lifeblood of the conservative movement and keep our message strong from cycle to cycle. As we near the end of 2021, things are not slowing down at the Republican Party of Wisconsin. We are continuing to mobilize grassroots supporters ahead of our crucial elections in 2022 and call out Democrats for their failures that are crushing Wisconsin businesses and families alike. You can read more about what we’re focusing on here at the WisGOP below, and as always, you can get involved by signing up at our website **[here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0bfZhAig058TAIOJhSOZVp8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=2)**. \- Team WisGOP | The Republican Party of Wisconsin stands with the Waukesha community in light of last week’s tragic attack on participants in their annual Christmas parade. We are praying for the victims and their families, and we support calls to ensure that justice is served on the attacker who caused destruction to countless lives. If you would like to support the community, consider giving to the Waukesha Community Fund -- a joint effort between United Way and the Waukesha County Community Foundation that will support families impacted by the tragedy -- on their website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=GhPaaNBzs54Gh5oH7cabF23uC1zwaMMb6ev7TBv5YisJwJTzpiC2LiTBzOEuTF_QEh0uzWISoxxE-zFUkyWDVw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=3). Wisconsin families are struggling with the impact of inflation this holiday season. From the grocery store to the pump, rising prices are impacting Wisconsinites’ ability to provide for their families -- yet Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and Democrats’ Build Back Broke agenda will pump trillions of dollars of wasteful spending into the economy. While Wisconsinites are already struggling, Democrats voted for hundreds of billions of dollars in additional debt, higher taxes for business, an open borders agenda, taxes on energy, and more. Democrats’ priorities are clear -- they will side with the far-left and special interests rather than everyday Americans. Next November, voters will remember Democrats' lies and their reckless tax-and-spend agenda. Then they'll send Republican leaders to Congress to fight for them. | |
The tragedy in Waukesha has cast a spotlight on soft-on-crime policies that have kept violent criminals on the streets. The tragedy in Waukesha never should have been allowed to happen. We cannot allow violent criminals to threaten our communities. Read about the issue, including the Waukesha attacker’s vast criminal record, in Wisconsin Right Now [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=5wg3don5l6_J12hXkf3HPcNYT6lUz2m18CPWRl8AJrzfrdyGuxcYGXIMLxzjh1Wy9Sdw51xft5xQ0wW9beBQKBTQoUvGdrEf-O-UMcvqZ6I&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=4). The deadline for county party officials to submit poll workers is TOMORROW, November 30th! Serving as a poll worker is the most effective way to ensure the integrity of elections in your community. Poll workers are trained and paid by their local municipalities to register voters, issue ballots on election day, monitor voting equipment, and more. If you have not signed up already, make sure to sign up to serve as a poll worker on our website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0R_kNr4x5AW03jFWL_9dJJI&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=5). Republicans are fighting back against trickle-down critical race theory in the University of Wisconsin system. Earlier this month, Assembly Speaker Robin Vos sent a letter to UW-Madison Chancellor Rebecca Blank demanding answers after news emerged that the school is requiring students to take a class that forces them to agree that whiteness means privilege. Read more about it in the Wisconsin State Journal [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=2-3jd5nLMwji5ivpZLIClZJ_HmZDkMXMkN7Vy2WRV0bnN1hahH1m6scLpkiQ3GZL_oqvRfBIRa7dKgefRbupi83jeNOLPo0jKvGmV7D8qf3rFsJU9MEyp1pZTgSX5nwz7UBHDCLxRdaJgYSXTuG_6DK4JChvFLv4QMgeXYRVSMOg2vM1ypk5bbib0l074X-CcgQockfHjxMjl8oAB8Ut7lsygJlLAnNSy1RZHQg0L3rRAIbY8bUj8FuUyfn73KBa&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=6) , or read the full letter on Speaker Vos’ Twitter [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=-jNYQHDSCODqvsvvkQjCebh6rcg5JEqnunqX-lQxlAdvHrbyiIO-FL2HJuqu8Yml8nlqx6GDKB6Y6-PGAsZbctPwXj9he4Pog5TYe8fXoOs&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=7).

### **In Case You Missed It...**
### [_WisGOP Statement on Madison Vaccine Mandate for Poll Workers_](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0R72aAQRdpUWAFwuxNARiAWA0WnHxOYcn6d3zsAL2JR-zYfXX_Cm1-uJyonOuHDpTMSgHo-ZaZfvMdnuq3IFRetj5Ae7XHFvAuVowxt_Nr5L&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=10)
The City of Madison announced a vaccine mandate for poll workers — just two weeks before the November 30th deadline for county party officials to submit poll worker names ahead of 2022 elections. The City of Madison’s decision to unilaterally impose new requirements is a departure from our election laws and a dangerous slippery slope, and it should sound alarms for any Wisconsinite concerned about election integrity and fairness in our democratic process.
### [_ICYMI: Mandela Barnes Collects Checks From Convicted Bank Fraudster_](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0QoC7rgm5XDC2WUpuTddVCC9Kk7qzorYPEddy4Q5nettEj7aAXkDix9bdq7e3YArSHt2P--MMmp8bWBlMzFWeyiXia1D8iDmjyrTmLd_nVAh&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_11_29_2021_v3&n=11)
The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reported that Mandela Barnes is enlisting support from a convicted bank fraudster to bankroll his campaign. The host of Barnes’ upcoming fundraiser is the liberal group Democracy Partners led by co-founder Robert Creamer, who was previously convicted for a check-kiting scheme. Meanwhile, Democracy Partners staff were caught admitting to inciting violence at Republican campaign events — causing Creamer to resign in disgrace from his position at Hillary Clinton’s 2016 campaign.

clean_body: The latest news from the Republican Party of Wisconsin | | November 29, 2021 Friend -- We hope you had a joyful and safe Thanksgiving surrounded by loved ones. This year, we are grateful for our friends and supporters who comprise the lifeblood of the conservative movement and keep our message strong from cycle to cycle. As we near the end of 2021, things are not slowing down at the Republican Party of Wisconsin. We are continuing to mobilize grassroots supporters ahead of our crucial elections in 2022 and call out Democrats for their failures that are crushing Wisconsin businesses and families alike. You can read more about what we’re focusing on here at the WisGOP below, and as always, you can get involved by signing up at our website . \- Team WisGOP | The Republican Party of Wisconsin stands with the Waukesha community in light of last week’s tragic attack on participants in their annual Christmas parade. We are praying for the victims and their families, and we support calls to ensure that justice is served on the attacker who caused destruction to countless lives. If you would like to support the community, consider giving to the Waukesha Community Fund -- a joint effort between United Way and the Waukesha County Community Foundation that will support families impacted by the tragedy -- on their website . Wisconsin families are struggling with the impact of inflation this holiday season. From the grocery store to the pump, rising prices are impacting Wisconsinites’ ability to provide for their families -- yet Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and Democrats’ Build Back Broke agenda will pump trillions of dollars of wasteful spending into the economy. While Wisconsinites are already struggling, Democrats voted for hundreds of billions of dollars in additional debt, higher taxes for business, an open borders agenda, taxes on energy, and more. Democrats’ priorities are clear -- they will side with the far-left and special interests rather than everyday Americans. Next November, voters will remember Democrats' lies and their reckless tax-and-spend agenda. Then they'll send Republican leaders to Congress to fight for them. | | The tragedy in Waukesha has cast a spotlight on soft-on-crime policies that have kept violent criminals on the streets. The tragedy in Waukesha never should have been allowed to happen. We cannot allow violent criminals to threaten our communities. Read about the issue, including the Waukesha attacker’s vast criminal record, in Wisconsin Right Now . The deadline for county party officials to submit poll workers is TOMORROW, November 30th! Serving as a poll worker is the most effective way to ensure the integrity of elections in your community. Poll workers are trained and paid by their local municipalities to register voters, issue ballots on election day, monitor voting equipment, and more. If you have not signed up already, make sure to sign up to serve as a poll worker on our website . Republicans are fighting back against trickle-down critical race theory in the University of Wisconsin system. Earlier this month, Assembly Speaker Robin Vos sent a letter to UW-Madison Chancellor Rebecca Blank demanding answers after news emerged that the school is requiring students to take a class that forces them to agree that whiteness means privilege. Read more about it in the Wisconsin State Journal , or read the full letter on Speaker Vos’ Twitter . ---|---|--- | | Want to help stand up for conservative principles in your community? Submit a Letter to the Editor! You can send a letter directly to your local paper by filling out the form on our . ---|---|--- In Case You Missed It... The City of Madison announced a vaccine mandate for poll workers — just two weeks before the November 30th deadline for county party officials to submit poll worker names ahead of 2022 elections. The City of Madison’s decision to unilaterally impose new requirements is a departure from our election laws and a dangerous slippery slope, and it should sound alarms for any Wisconsinite concerned about election integrity and fairness in our democratic process. The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reported that Mandela Barnes is enlisting support from a convicted bank fraudster to bankroll his campaign. The host of Barnes’ upcoming fundraiser is the liberal group Democracy Partners led by co-founder Robert Creamer, who was previously convicted for a check-kiting scheme. Meanwhile, Democracy Partners staff were caught admitting to inciting violence at Republican campaign events — causing Creamer to resign in disgrace from his position at Hillary Clinton’s 2016 campaign. body:
We need to get ready now.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20211129-2665-header&t=1&akid=2665%2E2526796%2EgIqYLN)
The 2022 midterm primaries are on June 7 — _that’s just six months away._
Alexandria’s general re-election campaign was the second-most expensive congressional race in last year’s midterms. And now with the news of a Democrat jumping in to run against her next year, and with redistricting in play, we could be looking at another real fight.
**We need to do everything we can right now to prepare — that means hitting every single fundraising target we set from now until June.**
[We need to reach 25,000 contributions before tomorrow’s deadline to ensure we’re on track to hit this month’s fundraising targets. Can you make a $20.22 contribution — or anything you can afford — to ensure we have the resources to send Alexandria back to Congress?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211129?refcode=em20211129-2665-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amount=20.22&t=2&refcode2=2665_2526796_gIqYLN&akid=2665%2E2526796%2EgIqYLN)

A Democrat just registered to run against Alexandria in the upcoming midterm elections. But, that isn’t the only thing we need to prepare for. Alexandria’s 2020 Republican opponent raised over $10 million against our movement from corporate interests and wealthy, conservative donors.
Now the same forces are coming together to try and defeat Alexandria and our movement in 2022, with three Republicans in the running so far. In just the last few months alone, they’ve already raised a cumulative $174,249 for their campaigns.

Plus, you won't want to miss a message from Liberty Champion Rep Erik Mortensen!** You'll also get to hear Kyle Hooten of Alpha News host a panel discussion with the heroic nurses leading the vaccine mandate resistance in Minnesota. Jake Duesenberg

Organizing everywhere and taking no vote for granted isn't just a talking point — it's the centerpiece of our strategy to win this seat in 2022.
#
You've received a bunch of emails from John + Team Fetterman about tomorrow's fundraising deadline.
Well, Derek, we think you deserve to know why:
Believe it or not, our fundraising goals we set are never arbitrary. There's actually a lot of math involved! Each month, we calculate *exactly* how much money we must raise in order to aggressively scale up our field organizing, host campaign events across the Commonwealth, keep the lights on at our new campaign office in Pittsburgh, and much more.
**After running the numbers just now, we figured out that if even a couple more folks from Cresco are able to donate, we'll be on pace to close this outstanding gap in our budget before midnight tomorrow.**
[**_Will you please make your first $5 contribution before tomorrow at midnight? Our campaign's plans to organize in all 67 Pennsylvania counties as we kick off 2022 depend entirely on how much we're able to raise before this big milestone._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/37778?refcode=em20211129-3650&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3650%2E434096%2En1izTr)

Honestly, John said it best when he first emailed you on Saturday about our big end-of-month goal:
_In order to compete with Republicans in the midterms, we can't afford to get clobbered in the reddest areas of our Commonwealth and still expect elections to go our way._
**Organizing everywhere and taking no vote for granted isn't just a talking point — it's the centerpiece of our strategy to win this seat in 2022.**
Together, we can add John Fetterman as that crucial 51st Democratic vote in the Senate. But we can't expect to do it without you, Derek.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: It is time to push back
body:
It is time to push back

Dear <<
Test First Name >>, you may not realize it but today is a big day
and it is likely not for the reason you think.

It is not
because the Supreme Court is about to hear a case that has the
potential to overturn Roe v. Wade (Praise God)! It is not because
the American people are wising up to the destructive impact
Biden's liberal agenda has had on our economy.

It is
because today is a day that embodies one of America's greatest
virtues: generosity.

Today is
Giving Tuesday. It is a national movement designed to bring
people together on a single day to support the causes that are
most important to them.

That is
why I love this day-it brings our communities together at a time
where politicians and the liberal media seek to divide us.

In
schools across America, that division has never been more
apparent. Children are being taught that our Founding Fathers
were massively flawed and that it overshadows the nation they
built. They are told that our Constitution is "out of date" and
needs to be "modernized." They are told that the color of their
skin is more important than the content of their character.

There is
no other way to say it: It's wrong and we've decided to do
something about it.

We've
created a curriculum that tells the story of America's founding
while promoting the values and virtues that make it great. The
curriculum works, now we need your support to get it into
thousands of classrooms across America.

You can
ensure the next generation takes the same pride in our nation
that you and I both share.

Today, on
Giving Tuesday, I'd like to invite you to join me in the fight to
preserve our American values with a gift to ACI. You can make
your donation right now at
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/giving_tuesday

Thank you
for everything you have done already.

For
America,

Ben
Carson

--
Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder
and Chairman

Cornerstone Institute

There is no other way to say it: It's wrong and we've decided to do something about it. We've created a curriculum that tells the story of America's founding while promoting the values and virtues that make it great. The curriculum works, now we need your support to get it into thousands of classrooms across America. You can ensure the next generation takes the same pride in our nation that you and I both share. Today, on Giving Tuesday, I'd like to invite you to join me in the fight to preserve our American values with a gift to ACI. You can make your donation right now at Thank you for everything you have done already. For America, Ben Carson -- Dr. Ben Carson Founder and Chairman American Cornerstone Institute Copyright © 2021 American Cornerstone Institute, All rights reserved.

| | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

subject: Americans find this “British Bulldog”captivating
body:
You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, “Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,” on DVD.
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqv6po7t6vbe3l4eiqssvsr8sb1q9b3r7g9aoiqg_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9jm0p35c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”** on DVD. Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziktefadvjje9stp4ka2usrvv2nigf6iks6sc0ao_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9jm0p35c9h2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgasbt3toi438p11njb5am4oaeg74mpirqhfpbc0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9jm0p35c9h2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

subject: Whataburger, Texas, and the fight for liberty
body:

---
| | Howdy,

I'm sure the subject of this email has you leaning your head to one side and chewing gum on the other side of your mouth...

Whataburger is just... well, it's dang good, Peter.

Love to get me a Sweet & Spicy Bacon Burger Combo, Whatasized, with an Unsweet Iced Tea, EZ Ice, with 5 Sweet N Low instead of sugar (cuz you know... gotta watch my weight).

Whataburger is not only a Texas staple, but it's also WAY better than In N Out.

So what does this have to do with liberty?

Well, every time I go to Whataburger (which can be pretty often), I never spend less than $10.

However, since I've announced my run for Congressional District 8, I haven't been by there as much because I'm trying to use as much of my own funds as possible for the campaign.

But I can't do it alone.

And so that got me thinking...

As difficult as it may be for us Texans to give up going to Whataburger one time, I thought to myself, "instead of asking people to give as much as they can to support our campaign, what if instead we just asked them to give up going to Whataburger one time?"

I know, I know Peter... those are fighting words.

And that's exactly what we aim to do. We've got to fight for liberty and to have proper Republican representation in Washington.

The last thing we need is for another moderate Republican to vote our liberties and money away, am I right?

And so would you consider making a minimum monthly recurring contribution of only $10 today?

If we all work together with each person doing just a little bit, then it lightens the load evenly and ensures no one person carries a heavier burden than another.

Because after the impact the scamdemic had on everyone in 2020, the last thing I want to do is ask you or anyone else to contribute more than you're comfortable with.

Simply click the button below, select the amount, and then tick the box that says, "Make this a monthly recurring donation."

Together, we can stand against the narratives that are so detrimental to law enforcement and are eroding away the very foundation of our great nation.

BOB'S ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY** "As our Native American colleagues tell us, our decisions today – legislatively and individually – should result in a sustainable world seven generations into the future," says Dr. Bob Lorinser. "I support sound environmental policies that protect our future and, especially for us, our Great Lakes." Environmental policy at the federal, state, and local levels protects the environment and conserves natural resources. It's also essential our environmental initiatives stimulate economic growth, employment, affordable energy, and businesses and individuals' rights. **Greenhouse Gas Reductions** Global temperature increases pose existential threats to our lives. As climate change worsens, human health, livelihood, food security, water supply, and economic growth will be endangered. The United States can address the global climate threats of greenhouse gases while creating stable, good-paying jobs and boosting our economy. It is not one or the other but a win-win.
* Dr. Lorinser will support initiatives to achieve a 100% clean energy economy and reach net-zero emissions no later than 2050 by working with local, state, regional, and national partners.
* We must enact a national strategy to clean energy and long-term community investment.
* Lorinser supports renewable, carbon-free sources of energy.
* Dr. Bob supports carbon fees that place a monetary price on the "real costs" imposed on our economy by greenhouse emissions and the global warming they cause.
* He will push initiatives to keep the United States the world leader in clean energy research, investment, commercialization, manufacturing, and exports.
* We must reduce greenhouse gas emissions from all sources, including household activities, factories, agriculture, and transportation.
* The United States accounts for only 15% of global emissions. Lorinser also hopes to be a Congressional leader in enforcing international agreements to reduce emissions and a worldwide ban on fossil fuel subsidies.

**DR. BOB SUPPORTS:**
* The **Clean Air Act** — sets national air quality standards and reduces air pollutants and their sources of ozone, lead, carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, and particulate matter.
* The **Clean Water Act** — establishes wastewater standards and makes it illegal to discharge a pollutant into navigable waters without a federal permit.
* The **Endangered Species Act** — prohibits taking any action that would result in the destruction or adverse modification of any federally listed species or its habitat. It prohibits an action that causes the taking of any listed species.
* The **Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act** – reduces hazardous pollutants at uncontrolled or abandoned waste sites and created the Superfund program.
* The **Resource Conservation and Recovery Act** — engages in hazardous and non-hazardous waste management and oversees the generation, transportation, treatment, storage, and disposal. It is required that waste be minimized and disposed of in contaminated lands. The EPA also oversees underground storage tanks for petroleum and other potentially hazardous substances as part of the agency's storage tank program.
* The **Safe Drinking Water Act** — maintains water quality for above-ground water and underground drinking water sources.

**Dr. Bob Lorinser will champion, fund and work closely with the following Federal agencies which carry out and enforce the environmental policies.**
* The **U.S. Environmental Protection Agency** (EPA) — protect human health and the environment
* The **U.S. Department of the Interior** — manages natural resources.
* The **U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service** (FWS) — to conserve, protect and enhance fish, wildlife, and plants and their habitats for the continuing benefit of the American people.
* The **U.S. Bureau of Land Management** (BLM) — manages federal land to sustain the health, diversity, and productivity of the public lands for the use and enjoyment of present and future generations.

It's also essential our environmental initiatives stimulate economic growth, employment, affordable energy, and businesses and individuals' rights. Greenhouse Gas Reductions Global temperature increases pose existential threats to our lives. As climate change worsens, human health, livelihood, food security, water supply, and economic growth will be endangered. The United States can address the global climate threats of greenhouse gases while creating stable, good-paying jobs and boosting our economy. It is not one or the other but a win-win. Dr. Lorinser will support initiatives to achieve a 100% clean energy economy and reach net-zero emissions no later than 2050 by working with local, state, regional, and national partners. We must enact a national strategy to clean energy and long-term community investment. Lorinser supports renewable, carbon-free sources of energy. Dr. Bob supports carbon fees that place a monetary price on the "real costs" imposed on our economy by greenhouse emissions and the global warming they cause. He will push initiatives to keep the United States the world leader in clean energy research, investment, commercialization, manufacturing, and exports. We must reduce greenhouse gas emissions from all sources, including household activities, factories, agriculture, and transportation. The United States accounts for only 15% of global emissions. Lorinser also hopes to be a Congressional leader in enforcing international agreements to reduce emissions and a worldwide ban on fossil fuel subsidies. DR. BOB SUPPORTS: The Clean Air Act — sets national air quality standards and reduces air pollutants and their sources of ozone, lead, carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, and particulate matter. The Clean Water Act — establishes wastewater standards and makes it illegal to discharge a pollutant into navigable waters without a federal permit. The Endangered Species Act — prohibits taking any action that would result in the destruction or adverse modification of any federally listed species or its habitat. It prohibits an action that causes the taking of any listed species. The Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act – reduces hazardous pollutants at uncontrolled or abandoned waste sites and created the Superfund program. The Resource Conservation and Recovery Act — engages in hazardous and non-hazardous waste management and oversees the generation, transportation, treatment, storage, and disposal. It is required that waste be minimized and disposed of in contaminated lands. The EPA also oversees underground storage tanks for petroleum and other potentially hazardous substances as part of the agency's storage tank program. The Safe Drinking Water Act — maintains water quality for above-ground water and underground drinking water sources. Dr. Bob Lorinser will champion, fund and work closely with the following Federal agencies which carry out and enforce the environmental policies. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) — protect human health and the environment The U.S. Department of the Interior — manages natural resources. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) — to conserve, protect and enhance fish, wildlife, and plants and their habitats for the continuing benefit of the American people. The U.S. Bureau of Land Management** (BLM) — manages federal land to sustain the health, diversity, and productivity of the public lands for the use and enjoyment of present and future generations. = = = If you believe you received this message in error, please . | | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

I’m a proud father, Texan, Marine Corps veteran, and Democrat. **I was born and raised right here in Southeast San Antonio, and now I’m running for Congress to flip TX-23 blue and bring our Texas values to Washington.**

As the son of a working-class Mexican-American family, I’ve always been committed to giving back to our country. I served 11 years in the U.S. Marine Corps, including two combat tours in Iraq. When I returned to civilian life, I used the G.I. Bill to go back to school and ultimately earned a master’s degree in public policy.

Since then, I’ve focused on empowering community organizations to support veterans and military families. At the U.S. Small Business Administration, I helped reverse the generational decline of veterans’ entrepreneurship. At the National Commission on Military, National, and Public Service, I helped develop policies to revive an ethos of service in America.

name: General Michael Flynn
subject: A message from General Michael Flynn
body:
| [](https://DIQ27272.trk.directiq13.com/click/?sid=00ab0c0ppitowaok2o2wkpm&linkid=0&link=d901a74a66964abab6a3058d6b189f6b)

| Dear Friend, It has long been an American military tradition that we do not leave our wounded on the battlefield. "Leave no man behind" is an honored principle of our Armed Forces. I have written to you previously about my friend Roger Stone. Like myself, Roger was subjected to a politically motivated prosecution in the Mueller witch-hunt. He was railroaded by corrupt prosecutors who withheld exculpatory evidence from his defense lawyers and a biased judge who didn't even bother hiding her hatred for both President Trump and Stone. Through the grace of God, Roger was unconditionally pardoned by President Donald Trump. I recently got the letter below from Roger's wife, Nydia. Now the Stones face an even greater challenge. After two years of relentless stress and near bankruptcy, Roger and his wife Nydia face an even greater challenge because Nydia has been diagnosed with stage 4 cancer. Roger and his wife have undertaken a spiritual, holistic, and homeopathic strategy to heal Nydia. Roger Stone has proven himself to be a valiant and loyal warrior in the fight to make America great again. Now we must rally around Roger and Nydia Stone as they fight once again, this time for Nydia's life. I can tell you that every single member of the Flynn family is praying for Roger and his wife in this time of strife and testing. While prayer is paramount, the Stones also need your financial support to pay for the life-saving therapies that are vital to Mrs. Stone's healing and the restoration of her health. **Please take a moment to read the letter below that explains why the Stones really need our help today.** Sincerely, Lt. Gen. Michael T. Flynn, USA (Ret.) [](https://DIQ27272.trk.directiq13.com/click/?sid=00ab0c0ppitowaok2o2wkpm&linkid=1&link=23ad53363f80446290e53eca421b2f2f) **NYDIA STONE**
Ft. Lauderdale, Florida _Dear General Flynn,_ _In February 2020, I had a full physical including bloodwork, x-rays and an MRI which showed I was in perfect health._ _That 's why my husband Roger Stone and I were shocked when only two-and-a-half months ago, a swollen lymph node in my armpit was quickly diagnosed as stage 4 cancer._ **_This has caused me to do a lot of praying, researching, thinking and reflecting on my life and what my husband, Roger Stone and I, and our family have been put through for the last two-and-a-half-years._** _The doctors have told me that stress is the great trigger in cancer victims. I have internalized the stress of the wicked, politically-motivated attempted destruction of my husband because he refused to bear false witness against President Trump, who has been a friend of ours for almost 40 years and who attended our wedding in Washington DC._ **_That began what seems like a never ending odyssey in which I have seen my husband refuse to lie and be vilified, smeared, threatened, gagged, lynched in an epically corrupt DC trial, convicted by a rigged jury, given a death sentence, financially bankrupted, censored, deplatformed, granted clemency, pardoned and ultimately vindicated on November 3, 2020._** **_Now I am waging a spiritual, medicinal and holistic fight for my life against cancer. Unfortunately I have been struggling with the side effect of lymphatic edema which has caused painful swelling and discomfort in my right arm. I have tried to maintain a positive outlook and good humor through this entire ordeal._** _The Mueller witch hunt has virtually bankrupted us and because of internet deplatforming and censorship as well as the demonetization of his podcasts, my husband has had a difficult time trying to rebuild our finances. While I have never had much expensive jewelry, I did sell what I had in order to help pay my husband's legal bills. The only thing I did not sell is my wedding ring._ __My diagnosis of stage 4 cancer and commitment to a natural, holistic and homeopathic cancer therapy to rebuild my immunity in order to defeat the cancer could not have come at a worse time financially for us.__ __The most effective all-natural cancer treatments include intravenous infusions of vitamin C, D and B17, as well as certain peptides and regular oxygenation of the blood.__ __Specifically designed THC and CBD formulas have proven very effective in fighting cancer. Unfortunately, none of these vital therapies are covered by insurance and my husband and I believe I need to utilize all of them.__ __Needless to say none of the vital therapies are covered by insurance._ This is causing us great financial hardship and why I must appeal to you for help._ _We will never quit fighting but we cannot do it alone. I hope you will call on your supporters to send a generous contribution to the[ StoneFamilyFund.com](https://DIQ27272.trk.directiq13.com/click/?sid=00ab0c0ppitowaok2o2wkpm&linkid=2&link=c189822fd1de43c898e54544491f5e53) to support us in this most recent crisis._ __We need your help now more than ever._ As we pray to God for the restoration of my health so that I _can continue to support my husband_ in his epic struggle for the truth and in his efforts to rebuild our lives and his livelihood and end the relentless attacks on us._ _Please extend my very best regards to the entire Flynn family. Roger and I are so grateful for your friendship and support at this time of adversity._ _God Bless You._ Mrs. Roger Stone [www.stonefamilysupportfund.com](https://DIQ27272.trk.directiq13.com/click/?sid=00ab0c0ppitowaok2o2wkpm&linkid=3&link=046a04fdff2241e4a8aa1d33bbec914e) [](https://DIQ27272.trk.directiq13.com/click/?sid=00ab0c0ppitowaok2o2wkpm&linkid=4&link=8bb3157f50cb47dca52a3c13d7264c45)

| | |

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39160192/318685156/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk420-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYWI3MmYxZC1mMzUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fKKD9yGyQLbMW_AwtdrcOAu2MzJXRcAbfKl7LwPpP2o=)
Peter – you might be wondering why I’m dropping into your inbox with a photo of my dad and me ahead of an urgent end-of-month fundraising deadline. Well, my dad's story has a lot to do with why I’m running for Iowa's Senate seat to defeat Chuck Grassley, so I hope you’ll allow me a moment to explain.
You see, Dad, who is retired now, worked as a Union pipefitter-welder – and it was a good-paying job. But his body got beat to hell over the years as he worked his tail off just trying to provide for our family.
I will forever be grateful for the sacrifices he made, and I will also forever fight for those who’ve gone through the same. But far too often, our government helps out the big guys with the fat wallets rather than the working families like mine.
**There's no clearer example of that failed, out-of-touch leadership than my opponent, Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA).** He's spent decades attacking union members like my dad and their right to build good lives. In fact, when the UAW members working at John Deere in Iowa went on strike for a better future for their families, Sen. Grassley had no idea the strike was even happening.
I’m so proud to be an Iowan, to stand in solidarity with the men and women at UAW, and to ALWAYS stick up for working families like the one I grew up in. That's why I'm running for Senate – and why I am determined to defeat Sen. Grassley.
**I’m in this fight for working families, like the one I come from, because Sen. Grassley has stopped showing up for us and representing our interests.**
[**If you believe working families in Iowa need a stronger voice – if you’re with me to flip this state blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority – then I’m asking you to make a grassroots contribution to help me hit this important end-of-month fundraising goal. Chip in whatever you can before midnight tonight to defeat Sen. Grassley and give working families in Iowa a senator who will fight for them.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39160193/318685157/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk420-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYWI3MmYxZC1mMzUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fKKD9yGyQLbMW_AwtdrcOAu2MzJXRcAbfKl7LwPpP2o=)
Thank you for standing with me in this fight.

With gratitude,

Well, my dad's story has a lot to do with why I’m running for Iowa's Senate seat to defeat Chuck Grassley, so I hope you’ll allow me a moment to explain. You see, Dad, who is retired now, worked as a Union pipefitter-welder – and it was a good-paying job. But his body got beat to hell over the years as he worked his tail off just trying to provide for our family. I will forever be grateful for the sacrifices he made, and I will also forever fight for those who’ve gone through the same. But far too often, our government helps out the big guys with the fat wallets rather than the working families like mine. There's no clearer example of that failed, out-of-touch leadership than my opponent, Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA). He's spent decades attacking union members like my dad and their right to build good lives. In fact, when the UAW members working at John Deere in Iowa went on strike for a better future for their families, Sen. Grassley had no idea the strike was even happening. I’m so proud to be an Iowan, to stand in solidarity with the men and women at UAW, and to ALWAYS stick up for working families like the one I grew up in. That's why I'm running for Senate – and why I am determined to defeat Sen. Grassley. I’m in this fight for working families, like the one I come from, because Sen. Grassley has stopped showing up for us and representing our interests. = Thank you for standing with me in this fight. With gratitude, – Abby | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | November 30, 2021
Voters in Massachusetts are turning their attention towards the match-up of the Governor's Race, and recent polling suggests that Geoff Diehl holds a strong lead over Governor Charlie Baker in a Republican primary matchup.
According to Northwind Strategies' recent polling, "Baker's favorability rating is just 23 percent among Republican general-election voters and leaners while 68 percent view the governor unfavorably. Diehl is viewed favorably by 49 percent of Republicans and leaners and 10% unfavorably."

First, we learned through congressional investigations that Donald Trump tried to fire his acting attorney general in the months after the 2020 election and replace him with a partisan loyalist who would help Trump weaponize the Department of Justice to overturn Joe Biden's victory.
Then, further investigation revealed that many of Trump's family members, members of Congress, and go-to accomplices - such as Steve Bannon - were potentially complicit in Trump's scheme to overturn our fair and free elections and keep himself in power.
Now, we have a reminder of the sort of corrupt, crony-filled government Trump and his allies ran and would run again if allowed to regain power: The Trump administration granted $100 MILLION to a federal agency, run by a college friend of Jared Kushner, to allegedly fix supply chain issues caused by the pandemic. But according to a new government watchdog report, NONE of that money was invested or produced results. The taxpayer dollars went to Kushner's buddy's agency and then apparently never made it out. And we are all now experiencing the failure of this "investment" as supply chain issues continue to pose challenges for businesses and customers, alike.
Friend, the Republican Party is completely beholden to Donald Trump and his toxic brand of corruption, obstruction, and dangerous conspiracy theories. Promises made that are not kept. Personal "deals' struck that do not help the American people. **Keeping Senate control away from this extremist party means competing in and winning every race we can, and to do that, we must hit every single fundraising goal.**

# Defense spending should only go to defense!
---
The U.S. Senate returned to work this week with the job of passing a critical piece of legislation--the annual National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). This typically bi-partisan measure is essential to funding our military and maintaining our national security. It was passed in the House back in September and should have already been voted on by the Senate--but Democrats have focused on out-of-control spending measures instead.
Now that it's in the hands of the Senate, lawmakers have tacked on almost 800 amendments to the bill, most of which are intended to push through other pet projects that have nothing to do with our defense. Additionally, this bill is furthering the radical left agenda by forcing our military to submit to Critical Race Theory training, which threatens the morale of our troops through its divisive nature. AND, a senator from Massachusetts proposes cutting our military budget by $7.6 billion and directing those funds toward climate action.
Our own two Colorado senators have tacked on their own amendment--the marijuana banking bill. None of these amendments have anything to do with our national defense. The NDAA must pass the Senate without pork spending. Our government's responsibility is to protect us from foreign threats, not establish a "woke" military. As the next U.S. Senator from Colorado, I will fight for our nation's best interest and stand against an agenda that's hidden in critical legislation.
Please stand with me be donating today. As little as $25 can make a difference in our cause.

subject: Pushing back
body:
Pushing back

Dear
Peter,

I hope
you saw the email this morning sent by Dr. Carson. Today is a big
day; it is a day that our nation comes together to support the
causes most important to us. It is a day known as Giving Tuesday.

Peter,
would you be willing to join Dr. Carson today in supporting the
effort to push back against the liberal effort to rewrite our
American history?

That
feels like a bold statement but it is truly what is happening.

Even in
elementary school, our children are taught that our Constitution
is "out of date" and needs to be "modernized." They are told that
the color of their skin is more important than the content of
their character.

This kind
of rhetoric will negatively impact future generations and how
they view our freedom; that is why I am fighting so hard today.

My wife
and I are raising two young children, and I am so worried about
the America they will live in.

As
parents, there is only so much we can do. My wife and I do our
best to raise our children in a loving, Godly home, but in a few
years when they start going to school, we may not be able to
control what they are being taught. This worries me.

We're
seeing that the education system is becoming politicized and
far-left agendas are creeping into curriculums. Dr. Carson and
ACI are going to do everything we can to give parents and
grandparents tools to help return it to normalcy- so kids are
taught how to think, not what to think.

But there
is some good news. Earlier this year, we, at the American
Cornerstone Institute launched one of our most important
endeavors ever - Little Patriots. It is an elementary school
curriculum that tells the story of America's founding while
promoting the values and virtues that make it great.

However,
we are quickly running out of time, which is why I am emailing
you this afternoon.

Would you
consider making a donation today to preserve freedom for our
future generations? You can do so here
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/giving_tuesday

Your gift
will ensure the next generation takes the same pride in our
nation and the freedom it provides that you and I both share.
Like Reagan said: "Freedom is never more than one generation away
from extinction."

I hope
you will consider giving to the American Cornerstone Institute
this Giving Tuesday. We are just getting started, and I have
faith that together we are going to accomplish a lot more.

For
Liberty,

Andrew
Hughes

--
Andrew
Hughes

Executive Director
American
Cornerstone Institute

Friend,

It’s been a while since I reached out, so I wanted to write to you today and give you a brief “state of the race” summary.
Look, I get it. There are multiple candidates in this Democratic primary, and for some it’s a difficult decision. I understand -- I like them all, too. | | **** Hi there, It’s Giving Tuesday and you’re probably receiving dozens of emails asking for contributions. So here’s why Indiana Democrats are asking you to contribute to the Party: **We’re just $597 short of making this month our top fundraising month of this whole year!** This will bring us one step closer toward our effort of electing hardworking, good-hearted Democrats who are ready to deliver a better future for you and your families in 2022. [Chip in and help us reach our $597 goal](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39167748/318720185/405560545?refcode=Web.stickybutton.&amount=25&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYTgzYjEyYy0wMzUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AK284aZ4qiRQ6iUYFtVkKLQch_AxKH8E7RABurrWYVs=) _Your contribution will help Democrats continue the work of bringing transformational investments for Hoosier families in all 92 counties. _ Think about what we’ve accomplished just this year alone under President Joe Biden’s leadership. If it weren’t for the American Rescue Plan, Hoosiers would not have the privilege of getting their COVID-19 vaccine or booster shot at the local drugstore. Indiana’s public schools received funding on levels not seen in over a decade. Further, Governor Holcomb’s READI program, broadband internet expansion, and Indiana’s childcare crisis are all being solved -- thanks to the Rescue Plan. Democrats didn’t stop there. Just this month, Hoosiers like Andre Carson and Frank Mrvan both voted “YES” for The Jobs Act, which will revitalize Indiana’s infrastructure system for the 21st Century. This means our roads and bridges will finally be repaired, more Hoosiers will have access to broadband internet, and our water supply will be clean and safe for all families to enjoy. **Indiana Democrats - not a single Hoosier Republican - helped deliver these opportunities for our families and communities. ** This is why we need you to help us make our $597 goal. Next year’s state and midterm elections will be hard. body:
Peter, Today is #GivingTuesday! GivingTuesday was created in 2012 as a simple idea: a day that encourages people to do good. Because of you and your gifts, we run year round and have been critical in electing candidates who champion gun reform up and down the ballot every year since 2016, in races for the U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, and State Legislatures. We have advocated for policy changes at the state and federal level and have mobilized thousands of activists in the fight. We have also took legal action to help gun reform legislation become reality. This is all because of you. Without your support, we couldn't be tackling gun reform from so many angles. Which is why, on this #GivingTuesday, we are asking for your financial support to keep our work going strong. [I am a college student with limited income, but I truly believe in this cause and I donate whenever I can. If I can give, I am hoping that you will to -- help us meet our goal of $50,000 dollars to make sure we can continue our work in the fight for common sense gun reform. Click here to donate.](https://act.myngp.com/el/zgZY-Jykfyf1IeKtGqRrWcgMXSFzEG0mTCyTBE8XJtc=/f3qwzhcb8e5iYUYw02igKm96UMIQhjbvXsbNTwfidjo=?refcode=2021&amount=25&recurring=yes) [](https://act.myngp.com/el/zgZY-Jykfyf1IeKtGqRrWcgMXSFzEG0mTCyTBE8XJtc=/f3qwzhcb8e5iYUYw02igKm96UMIQhjbvXsbNTwfidjo=?refcode=2021&amount=25&recurring=yes) We are looking forward to building on our successes and continuing to fight for public safety through our advocacy, education, and lobbying efforts, but we cannot do that without your help. Let me explain how your support helps us make a difference:
* We endorse candidates up and down the ballot and across the country.
* We run ads exposing representatives who put the gun lobby and NRA agenda above the safety of our communities.
* We create communication strategies and social media content and resources for our endorsed candidates.
* We organize canvassing and phone banking efforts and mobilize volunteers across the country.
* We fight back against dangerous legislation at the state and federal level.
* We rally grassroots supporters to advance gun safety and LGBTQ equality.
* We focus on advocacy and education to make the public aware of our cause and its importance.
* We take legal action to ensure gun safety laws are implemented and prevent them from being struck down.

body:
#

I have an important ask to make ahead of our November fundraising deadline tonight at midnight. I hope you’ll give me a minute to explain why this is so important.
At the end of our official fundraising deadline, we are going to report our fundraising numbers for this month. We have to put up a strong showing. But there’s another reason why this is so important.
**We’re running against at least one candidate with the backing of a $10 million Super PAC and another who has committed to spending $50 million in this election. We actually have FIVE opponents in total so far. We’ve endured millions of dollars in attack ads already, with more on the way. And Donald Trump flew to Arizona and directly attacked our campaign.**
So I need your help to keep up the momentum in the face of these challenges. It’s going to take lots of people making donations of $3, $5, or $10 to get us to our 50,000 contribution goal by midnight.
**My team tells me we’re close, and if we can get there, it’ll show that our campaign is more determined than ever to defend this seat. You can see how important this is, which is why I have to ask:**

Between the pandemic and the rise in homelessness, putting food on the table has been a struggle for many of our neighbors -- especially this holiday season.

The absence of affordable housing also means grocery shelves are left unstocked and restaurants are forced to operate at reduced hours because workers have nowhere to live. Montanans see this everyday, but folks who visit from out of state might not always make the connection.

**The need in Montana is massive, and the good news is that organizations like the Montana Food Bank Network deliver food to tens of thousands of food insecure families each year.**

**[If you’re in a position to give today, we hope you'll consider a contribution to the Montana Food Bank Network.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39171114/318732749/-1476205671?refcode=em-113021-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzEwYjQ2Zi0wYTUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=75YnIfv0kdw0l4JTosg5j6H03HaLW1y3YDIdrpK2viw=)**

_Team Cora_

body:
Gerrymandering must stop Gerrymandering is a crime against democracy itself and is especially cruel because it targets minorities, and perpetuates a history of disenfranchisement and discrimination. Just as minorities made their voices heard louder than before, showing their power in the democratic process in hopes of creating a more perfect union by putting Joe Biden and Kamala Harris in the White House – Trump’s racist minions and their new bigoted Republican Party will stop at nothing to suppress and regulate minorities from voting. It's official, friend.

**Redistricting in Texas is complete and Austin -- for the first time in decades -- got a brand new district.** This is a potential pickup for Democrats in Texas.

**Today I'm announcing my run for this brand new seat, Texas' 37th Congressional District.** In a moment I'm going to ask you to [**chip in $5, $15, or even $35**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39171587/318734521/1898666321?refcode=em-113021-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NjQ2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDNkMzZiMC0wYjUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qMS6RVrlXwpiYUq0WVMFgG_8u1YEAcP06GZdg1DoCkE=) to be a Founding Donor to my campaign. But first, let me tell you why I'm running.

I've lived in Austin for over 15 years and built a career in computer engineering at some of Austin's most iconic companies from Motorola/Freescale to Dell. During this time, Austin grew to be the 11th largest city in the country. As an active volunteer in my community, I served as president of a non-profit with 4,000+ members that provides free training and education. We've helped thousands of people, but I realized direct service alone isn't enough. We needed to do more -- and that's why I'm running.

This year we witnessed the GOP restrict voting rights and further gerrymander our state to weaken the voices of Texans -- despite the fact that Hispanic, Black, and Asian Americans accounted for 95% of Texas's population growth in the last decade. We can change this and take back Texas. Here's how:

In 2018, Beto O'Rourke was just short of winning a US Senate seat by 214,921 votes. In 2022 it's up to all candidates to work together and close that gap. We're expanding the electorate by building a coalition of all Texans -- Democrats, independents, and moderates. That's how we win and take back Texas.

In 2020, my campaign got the highest Democratic voter turnout in the history of the district. We went to over 50,000 doors in Williamson County, making it #1 in turnout among the top 25 most populated counties in Texas. That's why we're in the best position to repeat our success in Austin and help Democrats win statewide.

**With our election in just a few months, I need to meet every fundraising mark with strength -- especially since we're going up against the Texas GOP. I need to know you're with me.**

clean_body: We have the formula to win this seat and take back Texas in 2022. Now we just need you! | = It's official, friend. Redistricting in Texas is complete and Austin -- for the first time in decades -- got a brand new district. This is a potential pickup for Democrats in Texas. Today I'm announcing my run for this brand new seat, Texas' 37th Congressional District. In a moment I'm going to ask you to = to be a Founding Donor to my campaign. But first, let me tell you why I'm running. I've lived in Austin for over 15 years and built a career in computer engineering at some of Austin's most iconic companies from Motorola/Freescale to Dell. During this time, Austin grew to be the 11th largest city in the country. As an active volunteer in my community, I served as president of a non-profit with 4,000+ members that provides free training and education. We've helped thousands of people, but I realized direct service alone isn't enough. We needed to do more -- and that's why I'm running. This year we witnessed the GOP restrict voting rights and further gerrymander our state to weaken the voices of Texans -- despite the fact that Hispanic, Black, and Asian Americans accounted for 95% of Texas's population growth in the last decade. We can change this and take back Texas. Here's how: In 2018, Beto O'Rourke was just short of winning a US Senate seat by 214,921 votes. In 2022 it's up to all candidates to work together and close that gap. We're expanding the electorate by building a coalition of all Texans -- Democrats, independents, and moderates. That's how we win and take back Texas. In 2020, my campaign got the highest Democratic voter turnout in the history of the district. We went to over 50,000 doors in Williamson County, making it #1 in turnout among the top 25 most populated counties in Texas. That's why we're in the best position to repeat our success in Austin and help Democrats win statewide. With our election in just a few months, I need to meet every fundraising mark with strength -- especially since we're going up against the Texas GOP. body:
I appreciate all that you have done and are doing to support the America First agenda, so I wanted to share a personal story with you from my time as President Trump’s CIA Director.
& nbsp; &nb; sp;
Not interested? [Unsubscribe Here](https://trk.cp20.com/form?2yvft--fgxr-4qqlpo6&sl=2d&t=5&ac=gh7s)

---

I appreciate all that you have done and are doing to support the America First agenda, so I wanted to share a personal story with you from my time as President Trump’s CIA Director.

I want to take you back almost four years. I’m the Director of the Central Intelligence Agency...America’s most senior spy, leading the world’s finest intelligence service, climbing out of a plane in the dark of the night. I can’t tell you exactly where I was, but it was a challenging part of the world.

I’m greeted by a member of the ground crew whose name I never knew. Imagine my surprise when he welcomed me, reached out to shake my hand and placed in it a palm-sized, tattered Bible.

When I got in my vehicle, I read the hand-written note inside it: **“Mr. Director, you have been a light to me and to the world. Bless you.”**

I later learned that this gentleman worked for the U.S. State Department. I had no idea I would one day become America’s 70th Secretary of State, leading him and his colleagues. But I did know that, for at least one person, I had been a light.

This little story is not about me. It’s about each of us. It is my hope that our entire nation will manifest reverence for our Lord. The challenge for each of us is to be a light, no matter where you end up.

**But to do that, we need to protect religious freedom for every American.**

As President Trump’s Secretary of State, I was proud to lead the charge to protect religious freedom all around the globe. No one should be attacked by their government for simply living out their faith. Working alongside President Trump, we made great progress.

Unfortunately, our work is being undone by the Democrat majority in Washington. In fact, religious freedom, especially for followers of Christ, is under increasing attack right here in the United States from our own government.

The founding of our country is deeply rooted in Judeo-Christian values, and now Americans are being criticized and attacked for standing up for those very values. It is deeply troubling.

**Let’s be clear: no society can retain its legitimacy or a virtuous character without religious liberty.**

That’s one of the reasons I formed a new organization, **[CAVPAC](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yvft-1n4v9-4qqlpo8/ "CAVPAC")**. Our mission is simple: champion American values. Religious freedom is one of those bedrock values that must be protected at all costs.

Through CAVPAC, I’m supporting candidates all around the country who stand for religious freedom and who will never give an inch to the “woke” mob that is trying to silence people of faith.

---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yvft-1n4va-4qqlpo8/)
---

Do you share my concerns about unfair attacks on people of faith? If so, **[I’m asking you to join me in showing the mainstream media and the radical Left just how many Americans are opposed to these efforts to restrict our God-given rights and freedoms.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yvft-1n4vb-4qqlpo9/ "I’m asking you to join me in showing the mainstream media and the radical Left just how many Americans are opposed to these efforts to restrict our God-given rights and freedoms.")**

---
| | [Donate To CAVPAC](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yvft-1n4vc-4qqlpo0/)
---

It’s going to take all of us working hard in our churches, our towns and in our missions across the world to promote religious freedom everywhere and always.

Religious freedom is a fundamental American value, and it must be protected at all costs.

Fighting for our future,
---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yvft-1n4vd-4qqlpo1/)
---
Mike Pompeo

Peter,
Each month, we set fundraising targets designed to make sure that we cover all of our staffing costs and start to save for the major ground game we’ll need come the new year. Once we get to January, **we have to start buying things like voter file data, digital media ads, mailing literature, and of course we have to fund all of the new staff, organizers, and canvassers** who will help us reach Democratic voters across California’s 8th.

It’s the last day of the month and we’re so close to hitting our November fundraising goal.**In fact, we’re only $3,516 away, to be precise.** I know we can raise all of that today because I have seen our supporters show up for us every single month before this. All it takes is one donation from you and we will be that much closer to reaching our all-important goal.

[**Will you contribute anything—$10, $25, $50–toward our campaign today so that we can raise the resources we need to flip this district blue next year?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39172990/318741064/-538464252?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZjkzMGZjMC0wZjUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I4A6BVeZeZxyWR57G7GNtSU4YkozqKqe-TQhHVJkZyY=)

clean_body: Peter, Each month, we set fundraising targets designed to make sure that we cover all of our staffing costs and start to save for the major ground game we’ll need come the new year. Once we get to January, we have to start buying things like voter file data, digital media ads, mailing literature, and of course we have to fund all of the new staff, organizers, and canvassers who will help us reach Democratic voters across California’s 8th. It’s the last day of the month and we’re so close to hitting our November fundraising goal.In fact, we’re only $3,516 away, to be precise. I know we can raise all of that today because I have seen our supporters show up for us every single month before this. All it takes is one donation from you and we will be that much closer to reaching our all-important goal. = = I believe that we will cross the finish line today, but I can’t do it alone. Your contribution really does make the difference for us in an election that will certainly be influenced by who has the upper hand, the most resources, and the strategy to spend them well. I know it won’t be easy defeating Republican Jay Obernolte, but with your help it’ll be that much easier. Thanks for all that you do to support us. **A quick reminder** , please RSVP for _Holidays with the Shawn Hyland for Congress Fundraiser_ on Tuesday Nov 30 and Thursday Dec 2nd from 7pm to 8:15pm. Tickets are $50 per person and $250 and $500 for silver and gold sponsors, respectively. Refreshments and desserts are provided.**RSVP by emailing**[**campaign@hylandforcongress.com**](mailto:campaign@hylandforcongress.com)**today.** Thank you.

# Biden Administration Dismantling the Family
Today’s federal government is at war with our culture and the families that are struggling to raise their children in it. Biden’s education and justice administration is stocked to the brim with progressives seeking to implant upon the entirety of American culture their thin, ideological views of life, education, and justice. The results have been nothing short of a disaster. I am running for congress expressly because I am concerned that New Jersey doesn’t have candidates willing to go to Washington to fight head-on against Biden and diligently against cultural decay.We, New Jersey’s parents, are looking for relief from Biden’s agenda, and are fighting back in the halls of power. Our election this year in 2021 was merely the first wave. We are going to win bigger in 2022 and use our wins to secure parental rights for millions of Americans.
| [Will you contribute to my campaign?](https://hylandforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fadf394130a92311f650e3e36&id=313bf69cf9&e=5167ed8367)
---
School district board members and education unions across the country have rallied behind this radical agenda and have become the local embodiment of progressive ideology. They are the boots working on the ground to change America’s families through our children. Their mindset betrays the fundamental right parents have over their children. There are no finer and more essential advocates for our children than us, their parents. As Biden’s government works to step into this role, it is nothing short of a move to dislodge us parents from our essential role. And as a consequence, our children suffer.As partisan ideologies are seeping into our school boards and education unions, our elected education officials are becoming increasingly partisan and willing to do terrible things to push their agenda. Take Loudoun County, Virginia, for instance. Recently [the school board covered up sexual assaults](https://hylandforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fadf394130a92311f650e3e36&id=19ab7ee7c5&e=5167ed8367) and leveraged [the DOJ and FBI](https://hylandforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fadf394130a92311f650e3e36&id=694fc0bac5&e=5167ed8367) against vocal parents. Why? Because local parents were speaking out against their school restroom policies at school board meetings and this sexual assault was a direct result of bad privacy policy from school board leadership.

The GOP is going after a familiar target, team -- the Public Broadcasting Service (PBS).

A group of far-right Republicans recently introduced a bill that would **PROHIBIT** all federal funding for one of PBS' main funders, harming a network that has brought free, educational programming into American homes for generations.

But now, GOP senators are ramping up their attacks, too. Ted Cruz just called PBS programming **_“government propaganda,”_** and others are already on-record calling for defunding.

**This is the greatest threat PBS has faced in decades, so we've launched a live poll to find out where Democrats stand._We set a goal of gathering 10,000 responses by midnight, but we still haven’t heard from you!_**
**Do you support keeping PBS fully funded?**

Grassley enthusiastically accepted.**
Moments like this show why our campaign to defeat Sen. Grassley is so important – and why I need to ask for your donation to stay on track with our fundraising for the month. But before I do, I hope you'll let me explain.
You see, this rally has political commentators especially worried because top-ranking Republicans, like Sen. Grassley, are making their allegiances clear. Instead of choosing facts, reason and our democracy, they're choosing Donald Trump – the man who incited a deadly riot on our Capitol. But frankly, I'm not surprised at my opponent's actions. Sen. Grassley has a long history of advancing radical ideas at the expense of our country.
Just look at his time as chair of the Judiciary Committee, when he blocked President Obama from appointing a Supreme Court justice and then rammed through the controversial confirmations of Neil Gorsuch and Brett Kavanaugh. It's not shocking to me that he'll happily defend Trump's attempts to overturn the election and put our democracy at risk if it helps further his radical agenda.

Peter, I know that you've been receiving emails from my campaign, some of which ask for grassroots donations. This is another email like that. **But first, I want to make sure that you know _who I am_ and _what I stand for._**

My family immigrated to the United States from Japan.

They worked their hearts out to make a life for us here, but it was never easy.

**My grandparents and parents were actually sent to Japanese American internment camps during World War II because of racist, nationalistic policies.**

I grew up in a working-class household in Southern California, and I went on to work as a public school teacher for many years.

I know firsthand how hard working-class Americans work to earn a living and provide for their families. **So, when I ask for your support, please know that I don’t do so lightly.**

The truth is, I need to raise a certain amount of money to protect our seat in Congress and uplift progressive ideas in the Democratic Party.

I'm determined to spend my time serving my district, helping my constituents, and creating a more progressive country,_but I can only do that with the help of grassroots donors like you, Peter._ **[With less than a day until my November fundraising deadline, I could really use your help. Peter,

I hope you and your loved ones enjoyed a very happy Thanksgiving.

It's officially the last day of November, and it has been an exciting month in Congress.

First, President Biden signed the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act into law. This bill will invest in Washington State's infrastructure and I'm thrilled it includes provisions I championed to make our forests more resilient to wildfires, protect public trails and roads, and enhance the safety and power generating capacity of dams.

Then, we passed the Build Back Better Act through the House. This legislation will give working families with children a big tax break, lower the cost of prescription drugs, and provide preschool to all 3 and 4 year olds. It is also the biggest investment ever made in climate solutions.

My Democratic colleagues in the House and I focused on delivering results for families across the country. I'm proud of the progress we've made, and I'm ready to keep fighting for the families I represent, but I need your help.

**Yesterday, a third Republican opponent entered the race to challenge me.** While we don't know who our Republican opponent will be next November, we do know this will be our toughest race yet.

Tonight is our end-of-month fundraising deadline. Reaching our goal is crucial to ensuring we have the resources to protect the 8th district from our Republican opponents and to protect the country from a Republican majority in Congress. I don't accept a dime of corporate PAC money, so I'm counting on the help of this grassroots team to push us over the finish line before midnight.

clean_body: I'm proud of the progress we've made, and I'm ready to keep fighting for the families I represent, but I need your help. Peter, I hope you and your loved ones enjoyed a very happy Thanksgiving. It's officially the last day of November, and it has been an exciting month in Congress. First, President Biden signed the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act into law. This bill will invest in Washington State's infrastructure and I'm thrilled it includes provisions I championed to make our forests more resilient to wildfires, protect public trails and roads, and enhance the safety and power generating capacity of dams. Then, we passed the Build Back Better Act through the House. This legislation will give working families with children a big tax break, lower the cost of prescription drugs, and provide preschool to all 3 and 4 year olds. It is also the biggest investment ever made in climate solutions. My Democratic colleagues in the House and I focused on delivering results for families across the country. I'm proud of the progress we've made, and I'm ready to keep fighting for the families I represent, but I need your help. Yesterday, a third Republican opponent entered the race to challenge me. While we don't know who our Republican opponent will be next November, we do know this will be our toughest race yet. Tonight is our end-of-month fundraising deadline. Reaching our goal is crucial to ensuring we have the resources to protect the 8th district from our Republican opponents and to protect the country from a Republican majority in Congress. My team just let me know that we're falling incredibly short of our critical midnight fundraising goal.
#
Team -- my team just let me know that we're falling incredibly short of our critical midnight fundraising goal. If you have a second, I'd like to tell you why it's so essential to our campaign -- and our progressive future -- that we reach this goal and raise what we need _now._
The truth is that the odds are against us. With the Senate split 50-50, the GOP needs to flip just one seat to retake control for Mitch McConnell, and experts report that I'm the most vulnerable Senate Democrat in the entire country. Republicans are coming after me as their top target for defeat -- and they've already started launching attack ads to try and crush our people-powered movement.
I won't let them -- but I need your help. Unlike GOP megadonors, I don't have millions to sink into my campaign. I've got this grassroots team -- and right now, the only way I can fight back against these attacks and defend my seat is with your urgent support. That means hitting critical fundraising goals like this one.
**So I'll be direct: I'm asking you to make a contribution -- here and now -- toward our midnight fundraising goal before it's too late. This will be one of the most competitive Senate races of the cycle, and we simply can't afford to fall behind before we even get started.**

Our average contribution this month was $16.31 because we are powered by
people, not corporate interests. But with record-breaking fundraising
numbers, the political establishment has shown that they aren’t slowing
down, and neither can we.

corporate candidates and protect incumbents, while we rely on grassroots
contributions to help elect working-class candidates fighting for
progressive change.

We can’t let the status quo win. Not with so much on the line in the fight
to pass Medicare for All, win a Green New Deal, and expand our coalition
in Congress.

Justice Democrats

body:
This is a very simple question: do you stand with the people of Israel?
& nbsp; &nb; sp;
Not interested? [Unsubscribe Here](https://trk.cp20.com/form?2yx1v--fgxr-4qqlpo7&sl=2d&t=5&ac=gh7s)
