Let’s be clear: Israel is the only truly democratic nation in the Middle East. I have many fond memories of my visits to Israel, and I have many great friends in the country. I’m incredibly proud of the work we did in the Trump Administration to support our allies and secure the region.

As Secretary of State, I worked with President Trump to chart a course for unprecedented peace and prosperity between Israel and its neighbors. **We did what others thought was impossible, because we had the guts to get it done.**

---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yx1v-1n68x-4qqlpo2/)
---

The attacks we are seeing from the far-Left against Israel are downright anti-Semitic. Democrats are letting anti-Semitism be expressed blatantly by their elected leaders, and that should never be acceptable.

**I will never apologize for standing with Israel, and you shouldn’t either.** We need your voice to be heard in this debate. We cannot let the Democrats abandon one of our most important allies and put millions of innocent lives at risk.

Will you **[join us](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yx1v-1n68y-4qqlpo3/ "join us")** in sending a message that the American people are proud to stand with Israel, and that far-Left, anti-Semitism should never be allowed?

---
| | [STAND WITH ISRAEL](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yx1v-1n68z-4qqlpo4/)
---

America must be strong, defend its allies without hesitation and put the interests of the American people first if we want to live in a stable, peaceful world.

Fighting for our future,

---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-2yx1v-1n690-4qqlpo1/)

Secretary Mike Pompeo

body:

#
Hi — it's Kate.
I wanted to send you a message ahead of our first end-of-month deadline since Beto announced his run for governor tonight at midnight. [We're currently 18% short of our $200,000 goal. Would you be able to donate $3 or more right now to help power Beto's campaign to be the next governor of Texas?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/50275?refcode=ema20211130-164847&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=164847%2E444211%2Ec27gSd)
We've been reminded over the past year how badly we need new leadership in Texas. Whether it was Greg Abbott's failure to keep the lights and heat on during February's winter storm, his attack on voting rights, or his ban of nearly all abortions, Abbott has failed Texans again and again.
**Beto's in this race because he believes it's time Texans had a leader that represented their interests. But we all need to do everything in our power to change the dangerous and divisive direction our state is heading in.**
Beto is ready to be a leader for all Texans, but the first step to defeating Abbott will be raising the grassroots resources to go toe-to-toe with his mega-donors. [Please, will you chip in $3 or more to help hit our $200,000 goal by midnight tonight?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/50275?refcode=ema20211130-164847&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=164847%2E444211%2Ec27gSd)

That work includes creating a future where even the youngest among us have a fighting chance. Did you know that Ohio’s infant mortality rates are some of the highest in the nation?

body:
https://palmerforillinois.com/ [https://palmerforillinois.com/]
Peter

The greatest moments of my life (other than marrying Chelsea) was when my children were born. Seeing them join our little family was unlike anything I have ever experienced before, and filled me with a love I didn’t know I could even hold in my heart.

Their births also were a reminder of the immense responsibility that comes with bringing them into this world. Raising kids that become active participants in their communities is first and foremost at everything we do in raising lil David and Quinci. It is the gift we give to the future.

I also know that parents can’t do it alone. Our community helps us every step of the way, lifting us up when we are down and filling the gaps when we need a helping hand.

That’s why this Giving Tuesday, I am personally supporting the Don Moyer Boys & Girls Club right here in Champaign. Every day, Don Moyer Boys & Girls Club provides vital support and services to our local families. From after school homework help, to their Teen V.O.I.C.E. Program that encourages kids to build life-skills, the team at Boys & Girls Club is building the next generation of productive citizens.

Organizations like Don Moyer Boys & Girls Club are an integral part of setting kids on the path to success, and they can’t do it without our help. Today, my family will be making a donation in support of their incredible work. I hope you will consider making a contribution, as well to a cause that is close to your heart.

You can make a contribution directly to the Don Moyer Boys & Girls Club here. [https://dmbgc.org/get-involved/donate.html]

All of our children have exceptional talent. By investing in organizations that foster their curiosity and learning, we can bring that talent out and grow it, together.

David
David Palmer is running for Congress in Illinois’ 13th Congressional District. After years of hearing from entrenched D.C. politicians who care more about re-election than sticking up for the people they represent, David is ready to serve, listen, and do everything he can to make life better for the people here in Central Illinois. Fellow Conservative,

My name is John Castorani, and like a lot of other political candidates whose emails wind up in your inbox **I’m hoping you’ll give me 30-seconds to a minute to explain why I’m reaching out to you today.**

I’m a 29-year-old conservative from central Virginia and I love this country of ours with all of my heart. Until earlier this year I was a member of the United States intelligence community.**I deployed seven times with the Army’s Special Operations Command hunting radical Islamic terrorists across the Islamic MAGREB and in continental Africa. The men my team and I were charged with hunting down and capturing, in every case, posed an existential threat to democratic countries around the world, and I’m proud to say for that for 11 years my job was to track down and eliminate threats to your family and my own**.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b0c75f6d7aa04350b1b4987a3a585c7c&_e=e_BWkMQfv4VF5DnumTaSeoZhf8pXz5eC7r-1vJyvNhngGlerZoORWRggn8owGGx9hFbIei7VdIVLjBwaL8rp17C83DgIyldnWch9XsGFA-hE8Hny2eTAZcKXfNVK20wr4FulMxHswTQakSTNT3wGe7cogv5RdSep43nYerIaf-Yq2k34rDKprSzA9PX_vGxAbGeppoeSzUQo4TeaohsXS2_PLuJYbOcu0D_XQ9YJCF_pUx_oPQLTly4bZrDCHiR7pCQNCYDYCkhJoK-H-941jfeGIH_kG4StkogXKIMw8GH8ypOgxfFxGCwO6BI7AiDVQagXWlHHY43vHaetyagR3U5O23CSYKG4uF8MlVbz9Rt_lUScl3eEtSJLmHnBVvryeW1Vk8ZMBfdLruUGiPRgTqK1aJnPZNDK6sDnjDh-QNB-AO34thdehLjbgoGkLWxoY89anmhTpJroONmrGcXZanbHS0hTu4p0n6z4ZPIfNno%3D)

Upon the election of Joe Biden to the presidency **[I gave up my career in the intelligence service- along with my security clearance - to run for Congress](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b0c75f6d7aa04350b1b4987a3a585c7c&_e=e_BWkMQfv4VF5DnumTaSeoZhf8pXz5eC7r-1vJyvNhngGlerZoORWRggn8owGGx9hFbIei7VdIVLjBwaL8rp17C83DgIyldnWch9XsGFA-hE8Hny2eTAZcKXfNVK20wr4FulMxHswTQakSTNT3wGe7cogv5RdSep43nYerIaf-Yq2k34rDKprSzA9PX_vGxAbGeppoeSzUQo4TeaohsXS2_PLuJYbOcu0D_XQ9YJCF_pUx_oPQLTly4bZrDCHiR7pCQNCYDYCkhJoK-H-941jRad1wAtajZLaGMHO7v0EhTP6SnD9g0yrraLQonWNMq08omyUCkMDXj2feoktUL4ryk6kn3NYRwBWf4isDlDbcYNbpIFqhTo3iiRLzNWAiIcaOqc7Nj9nQx1lcc-hQ_d7nJCk6vVeuzUfkZzbf_P9acm8xDL6L-FuBrEjv47wCZT1UdGhv8jGTOfCA2qjwsnP30nwk3MveJJs7gJG9iji8M%3D)**. I did this because I’m scared to death that Biden is going to repeat the same mistakes of President Obama, and we’re all going to pay the price.

| | This sponsored message from National Republican Polling is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z7aoepa3qb6immd67dkok8ai88cd04as7h34v8r8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0spi68p35cph2bs)

| | | Dear Fellow American, Socialism appears to be on the rise in our country, especially among the young, and we want to understand the extent of that support. That’s why you have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a National Survey on Socialism. With your response, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans—views that we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. Every month, Hillsdale College is reaching millions of Americans with educational outreach. Your response to this National Survey on Socialism is essential in helping us form the most effective strategy in fighting for the future of our country. So please give your views on the political, media, and cultural forces that are promoting socialism in our country today, by completing this National Survey on Socialism: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2021-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z65srk7l2dk68mu80mc4aq4vbi4mc57n9j00q03g_rp22sh2s8i66pj0spi68p35cph2bs)** There is no doubt in my mind that, especially among younger Americans, socialism is increasingly attractive—and that this threatens the future of American liberty. As Winston Churchill noted, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” And education is the surest way to defeat it. If you agree, please stand with Hillsdale College as we promote intelligent patriotism and defend liberty through education. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. | [**Take the Survey**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zfdjpkamtoc1ihqt57q5ptgiotqa41vvelq23ago_rp22sh2s8i66pj0spi68p35cph2bs)
---
Warm Regards,
Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

body:

---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d486a881ec0c4f379031c9d26278d63f&_e=xZ2NlUPNARNm2WgeMyijDloTafoG3YxXzc9O1Mm2WA_qHIlMo4IJFyInhx3bD9GqFPrIY9FxKgbl6wq3DZIyH2oIjH1bNZGj7Ynv1yui3bLfYyYgTVsT_DlQNnGgzlmxZ0n0_VquRNXKGrXD_9O_aI5xWRRLdt3PxRBFV4GgeoILjE6Mlb1osUIDCeGWh3SlesClxPC6uudJHulaK89uSFzbtTYMWXrVEEq7xKiq9cse6ypILoWayaRVbz5wgoubhSum7JxueYvjkvlvfoenUt9mmWmRbPHXhEsYAuqwD_8C75pxnRpeIoaA4nfkWtIt8f7VZ1yqL0NICuQIeNWGO841mYzfADpjnBfyuvVXEdCSAbbDqMU7BiFJ6YWcMR6UfFk-TXxw4QE2nn_kGq1M7w%3D%3D)
Peter --
**The corporate media is at it again.**
If you only consumed legacy, corporate media sources, you'd think that a SUV mysteriously drove into a Christmas parade in Waukesha, Wisconsin, accidentally killing at least six people and injuring many more.
You wouldn't know the name Darrell Brooks. Or that he was a career criminal with a strong animus against people who don't subscribe to his radical beliefs AND who was recently let out of jail on almost ZERO bail. And you certainly wouldn't know that he intentionally rammed his vehicle into the parade, thereby murdering innocent lives during the holiday season.
[**JOIN THE FIGHT AGAINST THE MEDIA'S AGENDA**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d486a881ec0c4f379031c9d26278d63f&_e=xZ2NlUPNARNm2WgeMyijDloTafoG3YxXzc9O1Mm2WA_qHIlMo4IJFyInhx3bD9GqFPrIY9FxKgbl6wq3DZIyH2oIjH1bNZGj7Ynv1yui3bLfYyYgTVsT_DlQNnGgzlmxZ0n0_VquRNXKGrXD_9O_aI5xWRRLdt3PxRBFV4GgeoILjE6Mlb1osUIDCeGWh3Sl4JOE5fkHHQVBHeqiZI3nqCeSaEYW4KhLCaqodkj1ACgw5ekUpHAWP5NThi8N0mw6Uz_cwY81pxzWHY89QCRJ0aH0Wj5VxTGJRNrvXo3Hol24ykQUzyPjJkZiB3uQWyBHdUFOs96NtzVke34ztORYSxBgCfPx6ci9kyZoyouVFf-QbiE-44GeFpDLIlcbg6U6XG929so_z8cVOK5nOv4YSw%3D%3D)
Corporate media is more apt to characterize a frustrated parent speaking out at a school board meeting as a "domestic terrorist" than someone like Brooks who rammed a vehicle into a parade of innocent people. _**That's the current state of our media, DeSantis.**_
**And it all comes down to this:** Brooks' view was almost assuredly colored by lies peddled by the media for the past year.
[**DONATE TO MAKE SURE THE TRUTH IS LOUDER THAN THE MEDIA'S LIES**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d486a881ec0c4f379031c9d26278d63f&_e=xZ2NlUPNARNm2WgeMyijDloTafoG3YxXzc9O1Mm2WA_qHIlMo4IJFyInhx3bD9GqFPrIY9FxKgbl6wq3DZIyH2oIjH1bNZGj7Ynv1yui3bLfYyYgTVsT_DlQNnGgzlmxZ0n0_VquRNXKGrXD_9O_aI5xWRRLdt3PxRBFV4GgeoILjE6Mlb1osUIDCeGWh3SlqDPhIgK1UZ0AmKQw0LrzmavLbNF-LW_aYVzzyCp5Zxykj7rG12nJCDCGx9dvGKrHFliog5VOWQysGF2Dch8bEwzqzv1-5dNuWS6NG0znlDHokG8cU2Q18H3aNtOXAXveNq7-N5FxVvZwRut3Kc80NutEh1nWScnvYZnte0euNy8athVTeegiNVDzZOw4OBUMsNFi5d7WSQtY2KSSIz4JJw%3D%3D)
We can't let the media get away with creating an optional reality in which facts don't matter. We simply cannot succeed as a society that is governed by false, partisan narratives.
We need to join together and make our voices heard. I've been standing up against the corporate media since I've been Governor and will continue to do so, but I need your help to get my message out in the face of media lies.
[**Donate now to help me continue the fight against the partisan and RADICAL media that are seeking to divide this country.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d486a881ec0c4f379031c9d26278d63f&_e=xZ2NlUPNARNm2WgeMyijDloTafoG3YxXzc9O1Mm2WA_qHIlMo4IJFyInhx3bD9GqFPrIY9FxKgbl6wq3DZIyH2oIjH1bNZGj7Ynv1yui3bLfYyYgTVsT_DlQNnGgzlmxZ0n0_VquRNXKGrXD_9O_aI5xWRRLdt3PxRBFV4GgeoILjE6Mlb1osUIDCeGWh3SlRhhYau4w2u6YuWIXH6Prl9PCupUf1d0W3wrNyuDig_a6J7L8a3NIVVI9vHkfQz5vuuXsh93WCyvu8Tsi0oRjZnjh7F7KPYdePPw-n_kKq3-3CJVu6hMDQ6Lbpm1bzLc4RwvroUJS2G9B6V1sOFkh0zvKfg_CVV33Mu9KuzRVQlViV-zh5StvtXoh2CYLAcwEy3QyUa-1EBXW1xmozJZ0yA%3D%3D)
We can't let the media continue to tear our country apart. This buck stops with me. **Let's fight back together.**
Thank you for your continued support,
Ron DeSantis

In just a moment, we’re going to ask you to make a donation to re-elect Alexandria and grow our movement. But before we do, please give us a brief opportunity to explain why this request today is so important.
The truth is that while Alexandria has been working nonstop in Congress this month to fight for the boldest possible version of the Democrats’ Build Back Better bill, **November was a slow month for our online fundraising.** At this point in October, we had 604 more contributions than we have today.
We’re emailing today because we really need your help to close the gap.
[Can you make your first $3 contribution to Alexandria today before our end-of-month deadline? We’re aiming to hit a 25,000 contributions goal, but we might fall short unless we see a big surge in these final hours.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211130?refcode=em20211130-2667-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2667_2526796_Y09JfK&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK)
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211130?refcode=em20211130-2667-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=2667_2526796_Y09JfK&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK)**
The Republicans running to unseat AOC have already raised $174,249. We’re trying to exceed that amount each month to show we can defend this seat and keep growing our movement. Not because we’re afraid of these GOP opponents, but because we know that the full force of the national GOP and all the monied special interests will keep doing everything in their power to undermine Alexandria and our movement.
Alexandria’s last re-election was the second most expensive House race in 2020. We’re always a top target, so it’s important for us to keep hitting our fundraising goals. That’s why we’re counting on a late surge of donations in these final hours.
[Add a $3 contribution right now before our end-of-month deadline to help us reach our goal and make up for a slower November fundraising month.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211130?refcode=em20211130-2667-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=2667_2526796_Y09JfK&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK)
Thank you for being part of this movement.
\- Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211130?refcode=em20211130-2667-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=23&refcode2=2667_2526796_Y09JfK&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20211130-2667-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=24&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK)**
---|---
[](https://www.facebook.com/OcasioCortez/?t=25&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK) | [](https://twitter.com/AOC?t=26&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK) | [](https://www.instagram.com/aoc/?t=27&akid=2667%2E2526796%2EY09JfK)
---|---|---
Email us: [us@ocasiocortez.com](mailto: us@ocasiocortez.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/89772/images/Logo%20%282%29.png]
Hi folks, my team just gave me an update on where we stand with our November goal. We’re still behind where we need to be so let’s run it back .

As a career-long auditor, energy expert, and financial watchdog, I do not mess around with numbers. So, of course, when it came to planning this grassroots campaign to take on Dan Patrick, I took a hard look at the numbers. And here’s what I found:

We can beat him.

Look, when I first ran in 2018, the pundits and talking heads said winning was pie in the sky.

Then, I came within 4.8 percentage points of winning and nearly beat Dan Patrick. We ran the closest race for Lieutenant Governor in nearly two decades and outperformed the top of the Democratic ticket in two-thirds of Texas’ counties. Now, with your help, we’re in striking distance of turning Texas blue.

But here’s the deal: We have our primary election in exactly 80 days, and early voting starts in 60 days.

Simply put, we’re running out of time, and it’s critical we reach every single fundraising goal from here on out to prove how strong our team is — and that our momentum in 2018 wasn’t just a fluke.

So what do ya say? If you agree that the numbers are on our side, will you chip in today to help my campaign hit our November fundraising goal? The best link to give is here: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mc-email-oct2021

Thanks for hearing me out tonight. Let’s crush this goal.

Yours,
Mike
The Collier Committee
P.O. Box 14648
Humble, TX 77347
United States
[https://collierfortexas.com/] |
Paid for by the Collier Committee

subject: Oops! You weren't seeing double.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
We couldn't do this work without you.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4059?t=2&akid=12918%2E53494%2EGbt_sq) _There was a minor typo in the subject line for the email we sent earlier this morning. No, you weren't seeing double (though we might copyright being a Climate ClimateTM group...). That's our bad! We've sent you the email again here, sans typo, so it doesn't distract from our message: Giving Green recommends Evergreen as one of the most effective organizations working on the climate crisis. That's a direct result of your support! Thank you for being part of this community, and read on to learn more._ Friend, Happy Giving Tuesday. On this global day of generosity and gratitude, I wanted to write a quick note of appreciation—and to let you know some exciting news. All of us at Evergreen are deeply grateful for supporters like you. Whether you've been with us since day one or have just recently joined our community, whether you call your senators on a regular basis or just signed your first petition, we couldn't do this work without you. Your support has allowed us to stay nimble, adapt rapidly, and punch above our weight in the fight for climate action. **And that's exactly what inspired Giving Green to recommend us as one of the most effective organizations working on the climate crisis. ([**_We're going to tell you a bit more about Giving Green's recommendation below, but first, on this Giving Tuesday, I wanted to ask: Can you please donate to support and grow our movement to defeat the climate crisis and build a thriving, just, and inclusive clean energy future?_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4059?t=3&akid=12918%2E53494%2EGbt_sq))** [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4023?t=4&akid=12918%2E53494%2EGbt_sq) [**_Giving Green_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4042?t=5&akid=12918%2E53494%2EGbt_sq) conducts in-depth research to determine where donations make the most impact in the fight against the climate crisis. We're honored to receive their recommendation. Here's what they had to say about our work: _"Evergreen Collaborative is a nimble organization that is highly adept at timing its policy development and advocacy to the political climate. We support Evergreen Collaborative on the basis of its strategic, innovative, and impactful work; its organizational strengths; its cost-effectiveness; and its room for more funding."_ We wouldn't have been able to get to this moment without you, and we are so proud that your support has been going to effective and efficient use. But we still have a lot of work to do to defeat this crisis and build a clean energy future. [**_So today, if you're in the position to give green on this Giving Tuesday, we would be deeply grateful for your support. Click here to donate today. (Your donation today is tax deductible.)_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4059?t=6&akid=12918%2E53494%2EGbt_sq) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [$5 →](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4060?t=7&akid=12918%2E53494%2EGbt_sq)

Onward,
Jamal Raad
Evergreen

And thanks to redistricting, one of the most heavily gerrymandered districts in North Carolina is NC-09, where Charles launched his campaign for Congress. After spending the last few weeks studying the district lines, and talking it over with family and community leaders, Charles has announced he will run in the newly drawn NC-04 -- the congressional district including Cumberland, Sampson, Harnett, Wayne, and Johnston counties. NC-04 is also expected to be one of the most competitive congressional districts in the nation. = | | | = | | = In 2020, the Democratic Governor lost NC-04 by just 685 votes, or 0.01%. Charles? He outperformed the Governor in his district by 5%. We’re not statisticians by any means, but we feel really good about those odds. Folks, Charles has what it takes to win in NC-04 -- he’s already won in a Trump State House district before, and he’s outperformed the Democratic Governor every time they’ve both been on the ballot. And the issues important to the rural counties of NC-04 -- educational opportunities, healthcare access, environmental protection, and veteran services -- are the same issues he’s focused on while representing Robeson County in the State House, and they will continue to be his focus during this congressional campaign. To run a successful campaign, Charles needs to get out in the community and talk to a whole lot of new constituents. He needs to hear what issues matter to them most, and he needs to tell them about the values on which this campaign was founded. To do that, he needs resources. = | | = | | = | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Graham HQ | | = | | We believe that emails are the best way for our organization to stay in touch with supporters like you. First , this race in Tennessee is one of the most under-the-radar chances for Democrats to flip a governor’s seat. We know that Tennesseans are fed up with Bill Lee’s callous disregard for the pandemic’s impact on our communities, and that they’re ready for real change to improve our education, economy, healthcare, and more. But to attract support from national Democratic organizations and their resources, we need to show that our grassroots base is up for the challenge. Every donation you make—whether it’s $5, $50, or $250—helps us show that this campaign has real momentum behind it. = Second , it’s no secret that Bill Lee is relying on a massive war-chest of dark money and corporate PAC donations. Instead of talking about the issues and explaining how they’ll improve the lives of regular Tennesseans like you and me, the GOP plans to simply pour an obscene amount of money into this race. Unlike many political candidates, I’ve experienced the struggles that hardworking Americans face everyday.

I grew up in poverty. And I know the feeling of living paycheck to paycheck, without any sort of safety net to rely on.

So when Congressman Don Bacon voted to cut taxes for billionaires and big corporations instead of helping hardworking families, I knew I needed to replace him.

[**But the fact is: running for office is incredibly expensive.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39207065/318798139/1129282168?refcode=20211130_em_fr_b1_tv_30op_rs&amount=10&amounts=15,50,100,250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMmQ3YWQ2MS0zMzUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gxcQbJ6XZMGWsi--dWOqtBGco7EiRKWBLrkSZVuvuUM=)

name: Laura Loomer
subject: Once a year . . .
body:
Thanksgiving has passed, as have Black Friday and Cyber Monday, but today is “Giving Tuesday”!
| | | | [](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/2hX4zHLB3NhVq8leL00UjA/p8JwkxTDP892UDAjIGYcI0PA) | Patriot,

[](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/2hX4zHLB3NhVq8leL00UjA/p8JwkxTDP892UDAjIGYcI0PA) Thanksgiving has passed, as have Black Friday and Cyber Monday, but today is “Giving Tuesday”!

I’m sure you’ve been asked for a donation by a number of other great organizations already this morning, and I’d like to take a moment to make my pitch to you about [**why you should support my work today**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/2hX4zHLB3NhVq8leL00UjA/p8JwkxTDP892UDAjIGYcI0PA).

Americans are charitable. We care for each other in need, we care for our animals, we care for the poor, our children, and the elderly.

It’s how society should work . . . **but it should be YOUR choice**.

The Biden Regime and the Communists running our country want to force you to provide for everyone who puts a hand out – even illegal aliens!

Free college, free healthcare, free housing, and they’re even going so far as pushing to provide a basic “living” wage for people who simply refuse to work!

That’s what I’m fighting – **the spread of Communism in America**.

I ask that you [**support my work with a contribution today**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/2hX4zHLB3NhVq8leL00UjA/p8JwkxTDP892UDAjIGYcI0PA).

I’m fighting so you remain free to choose who you want to help, and how much assistance you care to provide – with charity.

**They want to force you to provide for EVERYONE, even when you’re struggling to provide for yourself!**

They want to take your salaries and retirement funds by force, and in many cases, provide it to those who know how to game the government welfare systems, and those who are too lazy and too selfish to provide for themselves.

If we don’t win this war, there will be no need for “Giving Tuesday” in the future – because you’ll be too taxed to even consider giving to those you wish to support.

[**Help me make America a place where people take care of each other and support the people and organizations they want to assist by their own free will**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/2hX4zHLB3NhVq8leL00UjA/p8JwkxTDP892UDAjIGYcI0PA) – through our non-profits, our churches, and our synagogues – **just like America used to be**.

Thanks so much for your time and attention today. If you’re able, and choose to do so, [**I would greatly appreciate any amount you can donate today so I can continue my fight against the radical left**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/2hX4zHLB3NhVq8leL00UjA/p8JwkxTDP892UDAjIGYcI0PA).

Respectfully,

Laura Loomer

Peter,

Today is Giving Tuesday, and if you haven’t already pitched in to a charitable cause, it’s not too late!

Giving doesn’t have to be monetary contributions. It can be signing up for volunteer time or community service. It can mean donating supplies like food or gently-used clothing. It can mean participating in group advocacy efforts. All you have to do is find a mission that is meaningful to you, and you can make a difference.

_Looking for a non-profit organization to give to?_

**Here are three incredible local organizations that will always be close to my heart:**

[**Doorways**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39208749/318803967/-154081244?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDhjMjI2Yi0zODUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-xglqQc-WmOvRjWpKLofHNeUPbi7UeuEoN9h7ntNY0E=&emci=cec11c23-3352-ec11-9820-a085fc31ac93&emdi=048c226b-3852-ec11-9820-a085fc31ac93&ceid=15633605) — For over 40 years, Doorways has helped address the cycle of abuse and poverty within our community by creating pathways out of homelessness, domestic violence, and sexual assault. Doorways offers a safe space and support for all women, men, youth, and LGBTQIA+ members of our community.

[**Bridges to Independence**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39208750/318803968/-2021955068?name=E348657&id=4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDhjMjI2Yi0zODUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-xglqQc-WmOvRjWpKLofHNeUPbi7UeuEoN9h7ntNY0E=&emci=cec11c23-3352-ec11-9820-a085fc31ac93&emdi=048c226b-3852-ec11-9820-a085fc31ac93&ceid=15633605) — Since 1985, this organization has helped provide shelter, housing, workforce development, and financial resources to those less fortunate. Bridges aims to empower struggling youth and families to be tomorrow’s successful community leaders. I wouldn’t be where I am today without hardwork and dedication, but also the help and kindness of my community.

[**Animal Welfare League of Arlington**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39208751/318803969/1402234368?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDhjMjI2Yi0zODUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-xglqQc-WmOvRjWpKLofHNeUPbi7UeuEoN9h7ntNY0E=&emci=cec11c23-3352-ec11-9820-a085fc31ac93&emdi=048c226b-3852-ec11-9820-a085fc31ac93&ceid=15633605) — AWLA has served the community for over 75 years by providing animal sheltering and control services to keep their animals healthy, happy, and at home. Growing up as an only child, I always wanted to bring home my friends' dogs or cats, but taking care of a pet while housing insecure was not an option for our family. Today AWLA’s Pet Pantry gives local families the ability to care for and feed every member of the family!

We know this is a battle but it’s one we must win.
#
Peter,
During his campaign and the first year of his presidency, President Biden has consistently said three words: Build Back Better.
Pramila fought tirelessly for the President’s agenda in the House, even as corporate lobbyists and conservatives tried to stop Build Back Better. Thanks to her leadership and our movement, Democrats were able to pass it through the House two weeks ago WITH progressive policies like universal pre-K, paid family and medical leave, action on climate change, affordable childcare, Medicare expansion, lower prescription drug costs, and much, much more.
Now, the President’s signature piece of legislation faces its next test in the Senate, against the same corporate special interests that tried to stop Build Back Better in the House. **Pramila’s fight to make the largest investment in working people, families, and our communities in decades continues no matter how tough it gets or how much money they spend against us.**
But to be honest, it gets harder to pass the strongest Build Back Better Act possible with each day that the bill sits in the Senate. This is the President’s agenda on the line. Historic investments in our people and our planet hang in the balance. We need to keep this fight going and deliver.

| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bbb_esolicit_v3&n=1) | |
---|---|---
Friend -- Before Thanksgiving, Nancy Pelosi led House Democrats in passing Joe Biden’s Build Back Broke agenda. This massive tax-and-spend plan would pump trillions of dollars of wasteful spending into the economy \-- yet **every single Wisconsin Democrat in the House of Representatives voted for the plan.** [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=KVYzWTFUuJ0SsyVZLAg-7ErOxjkzKTMQTmB5NQPKssjvkWjodc1gli5KqmbRjTqVXBzCZN7PNqvYHyRLhT18r-uWukVt0m3YezzwGkdhH0CRD_CYCiuG1IrUx6W-MYbk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bbb_esolicit_v3&n=2) [**Friend, we need to elect fiscally conservative candidates who will fight back against wasteful spending -- not liberals who want to blow billions of your tax dollars out-of-touch priorities.**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVyx_Pj3Wrv65qU6nSMxmd71_M9kp6UJDuhTR42jrKkT8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bbb_esolicit_v3&n=3) Here is what House Democrats voted for:
* Hundreds of billions in additional debt
* Higher taxes for businesses
* An open borders agenda that empowers criminals and cartels
* Money for illegal immigrants
* Amnesty
* Taxpayer funded late-term abortions
* A tax on the energy Americans need to heat their homes

These are the worst possible priorities as Wisconsinites continue to struggle with rising prices, a devastating workforce shortage, and an economy that is still recovering from Tony Evers’ costly lockdowns. **We knew that Joe Biden’s claims to be a moderate and a uniter were lies -- and now the American people are seeing it firsthand.** [**Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 to help us elect Republicans who will put a stop to Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi’s far-left agenda?**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVyx_Pj3Wrv65qU6nSMxmd71_M9kp6UJDuhTR42jrKkT8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bbb_esolicit_v3&n=4) Democrats even blocked commonsense amendments from making the cut on the final bill, including preventing religious discrimination, providing parents more choice in child care, and stopping money from going to the Chinese Communist Party. **The Democrats are no longer pretending to be moderate, and they’ve made their priorities clear.**[**Will you help us send them packing and elect commonsense conservatives in 2022?**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVyx_Pj3Wrv65qU6nSMxmd71_M9kp6UJDuhTR42jrKkT8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bbb_esolicit_v3&n=5)**** Thanks,**** Anna Kelly
Communications Director

| **Nathan Hochman Endorsed by Former United States Attorneys for the Central District of California for California Attorney General**
---
| **Los Angeles, CA –** Nathan Hochman, a former Assistant U.S. Attorney General and federal prosecutor, general counsel, and candidate in the 2022 race for California Attorney General, today announced he has received the support of a bi-partisan group of former U.S. Attorneys for the Central District of California, including:
* Honorable Nick Hanna (served under President Donald J. Trump)
* Honorable Sandra Brown (served under President Barack Obama)
* Honorable Thomas O’Brien (served under Presidents George W. Bush and Barack Obama)
* Honorable Debra Wong Yang (served under President George W. Bush)
* Honorable Terree Bowers (served under George H.W. Bush and Bill Clinton)
* Honorable Robert Bonner (served under Ronald Reagan and George H.W. Bush)

"_In the times we live in where homicides are on the rise, fentanyl is flooding our streets, and people are feeling less safe and secure, we need an Attorney General for California who is qualified, experienced in criminal justice, and committed to bringing back common sense solutions to our state’s pressing problems," _stated former US Attorney Nick Hanna. He added: _“ Nathan Hochman is that person. Over the more than 20 years I have known Nathan, I have seen his integrity, commitment to the law, and experience inside and outside the courtroom. He is the right person at the right time for this job.”_

U.S. Attorneys for the Central District of California have jurisdiction over seven counties: Los Angeles, Orange, Ventura, San Bernardino, Riverside, Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo.

In response to the endorsement, Hochman stated: _“Federal prosecutors do the hard work each and every day of protecting our communities and getting violent criminals off the streets. I am honored to have the support of such a distinguished group of prosecutors, from both parties, in this campaign.”_

Nathan Hochman is a former federal prosecutor himself, having previously served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney for the Central District of California and as an Assistant Attorney General of the United States Department of Justice. Hochman has also worked as a defense attorney, civil litigator, and appellate counsel and clerked for a U.S. District Court judge. Hochman has served his community on numerous charitable boards and as a member and President of the Los Angeles City Ethics Commission.

Since launching his campaign at the end of April, Hochman has raised over $1 million and received endorsements from prominent elected officials and prosecutors—establishing himself as the leading Republican challenger to Gavin Newsom-appointed Attorney General Rob Bonta in the 2022 election. ###

Glad I caught you tonight, friend.

I want to send you a personal note before midnight to let you know that we're still coming up just $4,311 short of our end-of-month fundraising goal. **[If you can, I'd be so grateful if you could contribute $3 to help us close the gap.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39210974/318822724/102973118?refcode=em-113021-all-2-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNGYzNDNlNC0zZDUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f_wG3Sdz0BphRatOiaGMocG6WNfvPGjcn5dfqLmh2Y0=)**

I'll be honest, I'm not convinced that money is the end-all to winning this race. TV ads and mailers help, but I think folks want to know their representative is going to be sincere and relentless in addressing the issues we face.

That's why from the start, we've been laser-focused on the issues that matter to our community -- housing, public lands, our economy, and health coverage affordability. We're not taking any voter for granted, and we'll never ignore areas that some consider "too red" to campaign in.

Ryan Zinke is going to be flush with corporate PAC cash -- there's no doubt about that. But this wouldn't be a true Montanan campaign if we didn't have to overcome some adversity to win. We've seen plenty of that in our state this past year -- whether it was in response to the pandemic or helping neighbors in need through these wildland fires.

So if you have the means, please use the link below to make one final contribution before midnight. And remember, it's not how much you give, just that you're making your support for my campaign known before this deadline.

**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cn-q4-2021](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39210975/318822725/102973118?refcode=em-113021-all-2-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNGYzNDNlNC0zZDUyLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f_wG3Sdz0BphRatOiaGMocG6WNfvPGjcn5dfqLmh2Y0=)**

Sincerely,

Cora

| | Friend,

A Renacci administration will **DEFEND OUR POLICE** , not defund them.

During last year's riots, we saw first hand what happens when violent mobs rise up. The Columbus police department spent nearly $2.7 million in overtime to keep the city safe.

**Just think what would’ve happened if we had _defunded_ the police.**
---

| | Even with a strong law enforcement presence, the city saw over $300,000 in damage and cleanup costs.

We can’t afford to find out what would happen if the police were defunded. ** I back the blue**, because without them your family’s safety is at risk.

That’s why I was proud to support H.B. 109 last year. It will allow officers to sue rioters who cause harm or knowingly file a false complaint against them. The bill also prohibits someone from harming another person for being a first responder.

As governor, I’ll always fight for bills like H.B. 109 that protect the police and give them the tools needed to make Ohio safe.

If you back the blue and want to **restore law and order** , then please consider donating to my campaign today.

name: Abby Finkenauer
subject: one final email to you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abby for Iowa Abby for Iowa
body:
Enough is enough: We need to defeat Sen. Grassley
| | |
---
Hey Peter, it's Abby again. I know you've heard from me and my team a lot these past few days, but I just have one more update before signing off for tonight. We're still about $4,500 short of what we need to raise before our end-of-month fundraising deadline in a few hours. We're _so close_ to getting where we need to be, and I really appreciate how hard you and this team have worked to show our strength ahead of a big moment for our campaign.

**Now that Sen. Grassley is officially in this race, we really cannot afford to fall short here. Mitch McConnell's allies already have $27 million in the bank to protect vulnerable incumbents like Sen. Grassley – and our only way to compete is by hitting our grassroots fundraising goals.**
So tonight, I'm humbly reaching out one more time to ask you to make a donation. Yes, these fundraising numbers are absolutely critical to how we win – but at the end of the day, moments like these mean so much more to me: empowering the working families Sen. body:
Governor Whitmer’s attempts to relax election security will only encourage more cheating, and further erode trust in the election process. | | | |
---
| | |
## Only 26 percent of voters think the correct person won each of the last two Presidential elections.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| Twenty-six percent? That’s an alarming statistic, Peter!

The numbers come from Rassmussen polling:
* 52 percent of Democrats and 20 percent of Independents believe Trump did not legitimately win in 2016
* 66 percent of Republicans and 25 percent of Independents believe Biden did not legitimately win in 2020.

For the past five years, **Democrats like Gretchen Whitmer and Nancy Pelosi have been doing everything in their power to undermine election security** — whether it was lying about President Trump and phony “Russian collusion” or changing election laws to make it easier for cheating to occur

**Why else would Whitmer veto sensible election security bills?**

And why would her administration be pushing to remove any security from absentee ballot requests?

_The Detroit News_ just ran a thorough article exposing the plan to allow absentee ballot requests without a valid signature. This is flat out wrong and flies in the face of existing state law.

Currently applicants for absentee ballots must sign their requests, and the signatures must be verified by election clerks. **The Whitmer/Benson plan would allow for absolute fraud by allowing online requests with zero verification**.

Following the serious questions of election security in the 2020 election, we should be doing everything possible to restore confidence and integrity to our election process.

This is what I’m fighting for, and what I’ll do as your next Governor.
1. **Strengthen voter ID laws. ** Currently, Michigan law requires an ID to vote, but voters are still allowed to cast a ballot without an ID by signing an affidavit. We must tighten this requirement. If someone tries to vote without a valid ID, their “provisional” ballot should be set aside until they can prove eligibility to vote. We require ID to apply for food stamps or welfare benefits, cash a check, purchase alcohol, board a plane, rent a car or hotel room, pick up a prescription or open a bank account, we certainly can require ID to vote.

2. **Audit the voter registration lists and clean them up.** Let’s make sure only those who are legally allowed to vote are on the voter list.

3. **Ban ballot harvesting** to assure voters – especially the elderly – are able to cast their ballot privately without any pressure, harassment or coercion.

4. **Verify the citizenship of voters** to make sure those who are living in our country, state and local communities illegally are not allowed to vote in our elections. Projections are that over 2 million will enter our country illegally this year thanks to the Biden administration’s lax policies. Many will end up in Michigan to join other illegal immigrants here already. We must ensure that only citizens are registered and allowed to cast ballots.

5. **Enhance procedures to allow election observers** complete, unimpeded access to the election process – both in casting votes and in counting them.

6. **Discontinue same-day voter registration.** We must give election officials sufficient time to verify that someone is legally able to cast a ballot before they vote. Currently, an individual without proper documentation is allowed to register and cast a “provisional” ballot on Election Day. Unless evidence can be found to dispute the eligibility of the person, their ballot is counted. We cannot continue to allow this.

7. **Block any and all attempts to allow universal mail-in balloting.** Michigan voters have the ability to vote by mail upon signed request. Ballots should never be mailed to people other than those who legally ask to be mailed a ballot.

Governor Whitmer’s attempts to relax election security will only encourage more cheating, and further erode trust in the election process.

**Peter, it’s time to Dump Whitmer. Are you with me?**

Please consider making a generous donation today to help me in my campaign to defeat Whitmer.

For the past five years, Democrats like Gretchen Whitmer and Nancy Pelosi have been doing everything in their power to undermine election security — whether it was lying about President Trump and phony “Russian collusion” or changing election laws to make it easier for cheating to occur Why else would Whitmer veto sensible election security bills? And why would her administration be pushing to remove any security from absentee ballot requests? The Detroit News just ran a thorough article exposing the plan to allow absentee ballot requests without a valid signature. This is flat out wrong and flies in the face of existing state law. Currently applicants for absentee ballots must sign their requests, and the signatures must be verified by election clerks. The Whitmer/Benson plan would allow for absolute fraud by allowing online requests with zero verification. Following the serious questions of election security in the 2020 election, we should be doing everything possible to restore confidence and integrity to our election process. This is what I’m fighting for, and what I’ll do as your next Governor. 1. Strengthen voter ID laws. Currently, Michigan law requires an ID to vote, but voters are still allowed to cast a ballot without an ID by signing an affidavit. We must tighten this requirement. If someone tries to vote without a valid ID, their “provisional” ballot should be set aside until they can prove eligibility to vote. We require ID to apply for food stamps or welfare benefits, cash a check, purchase alcohol, board a plane, rent a car or hotel room, pick up a prescription or open a bank account, we certainly can require ID to vote. 2. Audit the voter registration lists and clean them up. Let’s make sure only those who are legally allowed to vote are on the voter list. 3. Ban ballot harvesting to assure voters – especially the elderly – are able to cast their ballot privately without any pressure, harassment or coercion. 4. Verify the citizenship of voters to make sure those who are living in our country, state and local communities illegally are not allowed to vote in our elections. Projections are that over 2 million will enter our country illegally this year thanks to the Biden administration’s lax policies. Many will end up in Michigan to join other illegal immigrants here already. We must ensure that only citizens are registered and allowed to cast ballots. 5. Enhance procedures to allow election observers complete, unimpeded access to the election process – both in casting votes and in counting them. 6. Discontinue same-day voter registration. We must give election officials sufficient time to verify that someone is legally able to cast a ballot before they vote. Currently, an individual without proper documentation is allowed to register and cast a “provisional” ballot on Election Day. Unless evidence can be found to dispute the eligibility of the person, their ballot is counted. We cannot continue to allow this. 7. Block any and all attempts to allow universal mail-in balloting. Michigan voters have the ability to vote by mail upon signed request. Ballots should never be mailed to people other than those who legally ask to be mailed a ballot. Governor Whitmer’s attempts to relax election security will only encourage more cheating, and further erode trust in the election process. Peter, it’s time to Dump Whitmer. Are you with me? Then, we passed the Build Back Better Act through the House. clean_body: We’ve got hours left | | | Peter, We have just hours left before our end-of-month fundraising deadline, so I have to ask: We’ve got really big plans for next month, which depend on getting grassroots funds right now to become reality. And you know that unlike our conservative opponent Rep. Jim Cooper, I won’t take a single dollar of corporate PAC money to run this campaign — because I’m running on behalf of the people, not corporations. Peter, the reason why this campaign is 100% funded by our grassroots supporters is simple: I believe our representatives should be working for US, listening to US, and fighting for US. That’s why I’m in this race — to finally give working folks like you and me a voice in Congress. Thanks so much for your support – I really am grateful to every single person who helps us out. Together, Odessa Odessa Kelly Candidate for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District | To give by check: Odessa for Congress 2817 West End Ave, Ste 126-401 Nashville, TN 37203

Three students were killed and several others injured after a shooting at Oxford High School outside Detroit.
#

Columbine.
Sandy Hook.
Santa Fe.
Parkland.
Today, it's Oxford High School.
It only took five minutes for this tragedy to unfold but today, three students were killed and several others injured after a shooting at Oxford High School outside Detroit.
In the 22 years since Columbine, Congress hasn't passed a single, major gun safety bill into law. Well, if NRA Republicans in Congress refuse to protect our kids, we will FIGHT to elect a Congress that will.
[**Can you make a $3 donation to Giffords PAC today? [1]Charles Booker

Hi Peter, it’s
Bianca.

If we haven’t met before I’m the Campaign Manager for Charles Booker’s
U.S. Senate Race. I have a really important favor to ask.

We have a big fundraising deadline to raise $20,220 by tonight at
midnight. Reaching this goal is absolutely critical to make sure we have
the resources it will take to grow our grassroots movement in Kentucky,
spread Charles’ bold vision for change, and end Rand Paul’s career in the
Senate.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/13492?refcode=em20211130-1284&t=1020&akid=1284%2E346206%2EBbE1_q ]Can you chip in $5 or anything you can to help us reach
our big fundraising goal tonight? We’re relying on donations from emails
like this one to power our movement so we can transform the future of
Kentucky.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/13492?refcode=em20211130-1284&t=1021&akid=1284%2E346206%2EBbE1_q ]Contribute $5

I’m going to be honest with you,
Peter.

There’s a lot of people watching to see whether we will have what it takes
to win this race. Cynics will say it will never happen — but I know
something they don’t. We have you.

Together, we can turn out voters across the Commonwealth that have never
voted because they don’t feel like they have anything to vote for.
Together, we can build a campaign that actually fights for working people
in this country. Together, we can end Rand Paul’s Senate career, which he
has abused time and time again to benefit himself at the expense of the
people he serves.

Charles has made it clear that he’s ready to fight for a future where we
all have the same quality health care that politicians do. Where it’s not
just the billionaires who have money in their pockets and a gainful life.
Where poverty is a thing of the past.

Our people centered campaign is catching fire and Rand Paul is terrified
we have a real chance of beating him in 2022. They’re already spending
money against us, spreading misinformation and trying to use big corporate
money to drown out the voices of real Kentuckians.

That’s why it’s important we reach our November fundraising goal and raise
the grassroots funds we need to take on Rand Paul. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/13492?refcode=em20211130-1284&t=1022&akid=1284%2E346206%2EBbE1_q ]Can you make a
donation today? We’ll remember you as one of our earliest supporters who
helped build this historic movement to turn Kentucky blue.

Let’s make history together,

Bianca
